Personal Qualities and Behavioral Traits

  • Strong communicator, able to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams across different time zones.
  • High level of accountability and ownership over delivered features and system stability.
  • Passionate about delivering world-class user experiences through robust backend solutions.
  • Analytical thinker with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

Desirable Qualities and Behaviours:

The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and passionate about delivering a great candidate experience.

  • Lead full-cycle recruitment across LATAM, including sourcing, screening, interview scheduling/coordination interviewing, selection, offer management, and onboarding.
  • Source candidates through various channels, including LinkedIn, job boards, employee referrals, and direct outreach.
  • Partner with hiring managers to develop tailored recruiting strategies that meet business goals and promote diverse, high-quality talent pipelines.
  • Identify and implement effective sourcing methods across platforms and markets, leveraging job boards, social media, referrals, and proactive outreach.
  • Provide consultative guidance on job descriptions – including drafting and posting job descriptions, salary benchmarks, interview structures, and candidate evaluation.
  • Provide a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
  • Maintain accurate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
  • Analyze and present recruiting metrics and market insights to stakeholders to support data-driven decision-making.
  • Maintain and continuously build a pipeline of qualified candidates for recurring and future needs.
  • Ensure all recruiting practices comply with applicable local labor laws, data privacy regulations, and internal policies.
  • Stay current on regional talent trends, labor market conditions, and best practices in recruitment and selection.
  • Ad hoc projects as needed.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources or business-related field or 4 years of full-scale talent acquisition (attraction, selection and retention) experience.

Experience:

  • 3-5 years of experience in full-cycle recruiting, preferably in a multi-country LATAM context
  • Strong understanding of regional labor laws, hiring practices, and cultural nuances
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with business leaders and influence hiring decisions
  • Proficiency in using applicant tracking systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in using applicant tracking systems (UKG a plus) and recruitment analytics
  • Proficient in using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and social media platforms for sourcing talent
  • Microsoft Office proficiency (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint), internet and database management
  • Fluency in Spanish, English and Portuguese is a must

Soft Skills:

  • Strong communication, organizational, and negotiation skills
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment under tight deadlines
  • Proven ability to collaborate with stakeholders at all levels to resolve issues and promote best practice.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to travel when required (5-10%)
  • Working on a computer for 8 hours a day
  • The ability to support different time-zones when required, may include working a non-standard hour day

Salary Range: BR $85,000 - $105,000 + bonus potential

Please note, the pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, department budget availability, internal equity, geographic location and external market pay for comparable jobs.

title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.


What we are looking for
  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, with 5+ years in Azure environments
  • Expertise in Azure infrastructure, networking, and security, including VNets, Front Door, WAF, Firewalls (Premium + IDPS), VPN, DNS, AD, App Service, Container Apps, Function Apps, Event Hub, Defender, and Sentinel
  • Preferred experience administering Azure AD B2C, with deep understanding of identity and authentication security best practices
  • Strong experience with Terraform (IaC), managing scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience managing CI/CD pipelines with Azure Pipelines, incorporating security and performance testing
  • Expertise in Application Performance Monitoring (APM) with Datadog strongly preferred, including real-time alerting and troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with Hub-and-Spoke network architecture and cloud security principles
  • Strong database administration experience with Azure SQL Server, including cloud-based backup, replication, and high-availability strategies. Experience with the Hyperscale service tier is a strong plus.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, incident management, and high-availability architectures
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, including security compliance, role-based access control, and vulnerability management
  • Proficiency in Git and GitHub for version control and workflow automation
  • Experience in optimizing cloud costs (FinOps) and monitoring usage trends.
  • Ability to thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced remote work environment, handling multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience supporting a remote team
  • Azure and/or Security certification(s) a plus
Responsibilities
  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure, networking, security, and identity management, ensuring compliance with SOC 2 and industry best practices
  • Ensure customer-facing systems maintain high availability and rapid incident response, including automated failover and disaster recovery strategies
  • Maintain and enhance Azure Pipelines for seamless CI/CD workflows, integrating automated security, unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Implement and manage Terraform for infrastructure automation
  • Own the Datadog APM ecosystem, implementing best practices for monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and compliance
  • Implement DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, role-based access controls (RBAC), and proactive threat mitigation using Azure Defender and Sentinel
  • Continuously monitor Azure cost trends, implementing FinOps strategies to optimize cloud expenses while maintaining performance and security
  • Administer and enhance Azure AD B2C, ensuring secure authentication and identity management
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring data integrity and business continuity
  • Work closely with Engineering and Security teams, documenting best practices, infrastructure changes, and operational procedures
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

title: Planning and Scheduling Team Manager
description:

5 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Planning and Scheduling Team Manager role at Air Products

At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. Grow with us as we embark on building tomorrow together by being the safest, most diverse and most profitable industrial gas company in the world.
Reimagine What’s Possible
Rotoflow is a full-service turbomachinery OEM - providing a wide range of new equipment solutions and aftermarket services to our customers globally. For over 75 years, Rotoflow has designed and manufactured both standard and custom-engineered cryogenic and warm gas centrifugal turbomachinery used in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Products include compressor loaded turbo-expanders, generator-loaded power recovery expanders, and low-cost dissipative expanders. We offer new equipment designs, rerates, upgrades and repair along with field services, engineering evaluations, reliability, troubleshooting, training, remote diagnostics/data monitoring, shop services, and new equipment replacements for all types of centrifugal and reciprocating equipment. Our customers are served globally through regional service centers supported by both regional and centralized execution teams.
Gardner Cryogenics designs and manufactures high-performance, highly reliable, long-lasting storage tanks used to transport hydrogen and helium molecules around the globe. With more than six decades of experience, Gardner provides customers with industry-leading technology that enables them to cost-effectively move and store molecules with near zero loss. The unique technology developed by Gardner provides the lowest heat-leak for the highest yield when transporting, storing, and transferring helium and hydrogen.
We are seeking a results-oriented Planning and Scheduling Team Manager for our Gardner Cryogenics and Rotoflow manufacturing facilities, within the Lehigh Valley, PA. This position will be responsible for managing planning and scheduling team and overseeing the entire process from new order intake through delivery of contract, including aggregating information for resource planning, reporting of on-time delivery metrics, and helping to drive process improvements in the speed of execution, process efficiency and fulfilment of orders. This position interfaces closely with Sales and Proposals, Manufacturing, Project Management, Engineering, Procurement and Supply Chain to ensure execution and manufacturing dates are being met. This position will be located in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania and will split time between the Rotoflow and Gardner facilities.
What's In It For You
At Air Products we foster a culture of inclusion where every voice is heard, and everyone feels they belong and matter. Additionally, we offer competitive pay and great benefits for our employees. Check out some of our benefits below!

  • Affordable Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance (day 1 of employment)
  • 401k with 100% vested company core and match
  • Paid Vacation, holidays + sick time
  • Paid Parental leave (Up to 8 weeks)
  • Backup Child and Adult Care benefit
  • Adoption assistance
  • Flexible spending accounts (medical, dependent daycare)
  • Life Insurance (AD&D- Paid for by Air Products), Supplemental AD&D
  • Legal Plan & Identity theft coverage
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Many more supplemental benefits available
Key Job Responsibilities
  • Leading and developing the team of planners and schedulers across Gardner and Rotoflow,
  • Acting as a mentor, guide, and decision maker for the team to enable peak performance and remove barriers to progress,
  • Conducting performance evaluations and direct day-to-day management of team members,
  • Setting overarching goals, objectives, and development plans for the team and team members aligned with leadership cascaded goals,
  • Driving the team to efficiently and effectively plan and schedule activities aligned with Project Management milestones and delivery schedules,
  • Owning and driving enhancement and improving accuracy of the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) process and reporting out to the Leadership Team,
  • Translating sales opportunity pipeline into workforce and facility demand and capacity planning and scheduling (S&OP),
  • Working closely with Sales and Proposals to anticipate order timing and align proposal schedules and deliveries with current workload, supplier loading and availability, and facility capacity to ensure appropriate customer deliveries are achievable,
  • Setting priorities, finding solutions, and collaborating with all disciplines within the business to enable the faithful execution of work,
  • Driving the optimization of plans and schedules based on inputs (part availability, resource availability, work center availability, etc.) to accommodate unplanned or unforeseen circumstances such as customer emergencies,
  • Developing a world class planning and scheduling work processes, systems, and tools to enable efficient and effective execution of all aspects of work aligned with the business growth goals,
  • Assessing and resolving limitations, gaps, constraints, bottlenecks, delays, and other unplanned barriers impacting engineering and manufacturing,
  • Leading production meetings,
  • Developing and owning key performance indicators for planning and scheduling and reporting out to the Leadership Team,
Minimum Hiring Requirements
  • B.S. in a technical discipline preferred. Experience considered in lieu of a technical degree.
  • Minimum 5 years of planning and scheduling experience with discrete equipment manufacturing or similar.
  • Prior leadership experience leading a team of direct reports.
  • Exemplify a passion for winning and ability to motivate teams.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Production Planning module preferred.
  • Certifications such as PPM, APICS, ASM, or related are a strong plus.
  • Experience with MS Office Suite, (Excel, Word, Project, Outlook, PowerPoint) required.
  • Broad strategic thinker, with a clear vision and direction to improve business performance.
  • Proven track record for planning and scheduling process improvement and results.
  • Advanced problem-solving skills. Identify and recommend alternative solutions and translate complex concepts into simplified and understandable examples.
  • Detail, goal, and results oriented, organized, creative, self-motivated, collaborative, and customer focused.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills (written, verbal and presentation).
  • Highly effective communication, collaboration, conflict management, performance management, data driven and analytical approach.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to work independently on multiple concurrent projects or tasks and collaboratively with engineers, technicians, and suppliers in shop, office, and field environments.
  • High energy, desire to learn new skills, and desire to understand the specifics of the processes and inter-related steps that are required to fulfil a variety of orders, from design, engineering, procurement, and manufacturing.
  • Ability to create an environment of trust and consistently exhibit a positive attitude.

As a Veteran-friendly organization, we actively encourage and welcome Veterans to apply for various roles within our company. We are the world’s largest hydrogen producer with over 80 years of industrial gas experience. We are hydrogen and industrial gas experts delivering safe, end-to-end solutions, investing in real, clean energy projects at scale, and driving the industry forward to generate a cleaner future.

  • Experiência com projetos de engenharia de segurança industrial, incluindo: Redes de incêndio (hidrantes, sprinklers e detectores), rotas de fuga, saídas de emergência, sistemas de combate e detecção de incêndios;
  • Conhecimento de normas técnicas e regulatórias aplicáveis, como NR-10, NR-13, NR-20, NR-23, NFPA, API e IEC 61511;
  • Boa comunicação técnica e postura para interação com clientes e times multidisciplinares;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em São Paulo ou Rio de Janeiro;
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em outras frentes técnicas da SANDECH, conforme demanda.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Segurança de Processos, Gerenciamento de Riscos Industriais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificações técnicas específicas em HAZOP, LOPA, FMEA ou normas como NFPA, API, IEC 61511;
  • Experiência anterior em consultorias de engenharia ou empresas do setor industrial com foco em segurança de processos;
  • Familiaridade com softwares de análise de riscos, como PHA Pro, PHAWorks, BowTie XP, entre outros;
  • Conhecimentos de projetos multidisciplinares (ex: processos, instrumentação, automação, layout de plantas industriais);

Certificações Obrigatórias:

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno
description:
Sobre nós
A Evolucional acredita que o uso de dados pode transformar a educação e o processo de aprendizagem. Atuamos, desde 2014, oferecendo simulados e avaliações para escolas em todo o Brasil. A partir disso, geramos dados precisos sobre o conhecimento dos alunos, e ajudamos as instituições de ensino na transformação da gestão pedagógica.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Participar do planejamento e da arquitetura de aplicações web, definindo estrutura de pastas, padrões de componentes e fluxos de dados.
  • Implementar interfaces responsivas e acessíveis, seguindo as melhores práticas de UI/UX.
  • Desenvolver componentes reutilizáveis em ReactJS e/ou Angular, garantindo alta performance e manutenibilidade.
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs REST, tratando de forma eficiente requisições assíncronas, autenticação e tratamento de erros.
  • Escrever testes unitários e de integração que garantam robustez e confiabilidade ao código.
  • Conduzir code reviews e tutorias, promovendo qualidade de código e compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Colaborar com designers, back-end e demais times em ciclos de entrega ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em ReactJS e/ou Angular, com projetos entregues em produção.
  • Domínio de JavaScript (ES6+) , incluindo tópicos como promessas, async/await, módulos e closure.
  • HTML5 semântico e CSS3 , com entendimento aprofundado de flexbox, grid e responsividade.
  • Experiência com pré-processadores (SASS) ou bibliotecas de CSS-in-JS (styled-components).
  • Prática na integração de APIs REST : consumo, mapeamento de dados e otimização de requisições.
  • Vivência em arquitetura de projetos front-end, definição de padrões de código e organização de repositórios.
  • Experiência comprovada em code review e aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Habilidade em criar e manter testes unitários para componentes e serviços.

Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

  • TypeScript : tipagem estática, generics e uso em projetos complexos.
  • Ferramentas de testes como Jest e Testing Library , com cobertura de testes significativa.
  • Configuração e otimização de bundlers: Webpack , Vite ou similares.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis, CI/CD e pipelines de automação (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • Experiência com frameworks de design system (Storybook, Bit) ou bibliotecas de UI.

Competências Comportamentais Necessárias

  • Proatividade e senso de dono
  • – Antecipar desafios, sugerir melhorias e assumir responsabilidade pelos resultados.
  • Comunicação clara e empática
  • – Transmitir ideias de forma objetiva, ouvir ativamente e dar/receber feedback construtivo.
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe
  • – Compartilhar conhecimento, apoiar colegas em bloqueios e alinhar-se com diferentes áreas (design, back-end, QA).
  • Orientação a resultados
  • – Manter o foco em metas e prazos, equilibrando qualidade de código e entregas ágeis.
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade
  • – Ajustar-se rapidamente a mudanças de requisitos, novas tecnologias e prioridades de negócio.
  • Organização e gestão do tempo
  • – Priorizar tarefas, estimar prazos de forma realista e garantir entregas dentro do planejado.
  • Curiosidade e aprendizado contínuo
  • – Buscar ativamente novas ferramentas, frameworks e boas práticas para evoluir o produto e o próprio conhecimento.
  • Resiliência e gestão de pressão
  • – Manter a calma sob prazos apertados, lidar bem com retrabalho e aprender com erros.
  • Empatia com o usuário final
  • – Colocar-se no lugar de quem utiliza a aplicação, garantindo usabilidade, acessibilidade e boa experiência.

Aqui, você vai encontrar um espaço acolhedor, que irá dar oportunidade para que você aprenda e se desenvolva! Fazemos isso por meio de um trabalho em equipe harmonioso, que conta com pessoas qualificadas e abertas a ensinar e aprender, buscando sempre obter os melhores resultados para o time!

We deploy long-term capital through direct, and fund investments across the capital structure to diversify our portfolio. You will help to preserve and enhance the value of our direct private and public equity investments, working with top management teams and board of directors.

The Sao Paulo team was established in 2015, and currently has nine investment professionals. The team is focused on analyzing opportunities in South and Central America, as well as managing the investments made since 2013 in the region. It is integrated into the global team which operates from London, New York, Singapore and Sao Paulo.

Illustrative investments include Aegea (water and sanitation in Brazil), CART/Eixo SP (toll roads in Brazil), V.tal (fiber optics in Brazil), Neoenergia Transmission (power transmission in Brazil), NTS (gas pipeline in Brazil) and Isagen (power generation in Colombia), amongst others. GIC Infrastructure approaches investments with a buy and hold perspective and manages assets with a long-term perspective. We focus on minority / co-control investments alongside industrial and financial partners and have consolidated ourselves as one of the most active investors in the sector and region.

We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our Sao Paulo team as an Analyst. GIC desires to become the leading long term global infrastructure investor and an outstanding career path is available for high performers.
What impact can you make in this role
You will be part of a team that invests into infrastructure companies with stable and predictable cash flows, reasonable risk-adjusted returns and strong impact to local economies.

What you will do as an Analyst
• Play a central role in growing GIC Infrastructure’s portfolio and supporting existing investments in the region.
• Under the supervision of the senior team, play an integral role in the full deal lifecycle: deal screening, approvals, execution, asset management and, when appropriate, exits.
• Take on primary role in the financial modeling of transactions, deal with senior management, external advisors and banks.
• Play a key part in deal screening and appraisal, contributing to transaction analysis, and helping prepare the documentation to support investment decisions to investment committee.
• Investment focus is likely to be biased towards, but not limited to, the power, midstream, transportation, digital infrastructure and water utility sectors. No experience in infrastructure sectors is required, but the candidate will be required to conduct financial research on public and private companies for potential acquisitions.
• The team operates in a flat and meritocratic culture, empowering staff with open communications and robust challenges. Being a team player and interacting with counterparties in a way that builds on our reputation is everyone’s responsibility.
What makes you a successful candidate?
• Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university with coursework emphasizing business administration, economics, accounting, finance, and/or engineering. Graduation date between June 2024 and June 2025.
• Previous experience working for a private equity fund, institutional investors, or for investment banks as part of the M&A advisory or Equity research team. Experience in the infrastructure sector is not required.
• Outstanding financial modelling skills are assumed and will be tested. The ability to build models from scratch is required, as well as model review and scenario development.
• You will be detail-oriented with a hands-on attitude to deal execution and will thrive in a culture of high-expectations and personal responsibility to own the investment.
• Strong commercial and intellectual curiosity is a requirement to perform well and advance.
Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-Term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.
Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office at least four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

We are an equal opportunity employer
As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

  1. Trabalhar diretamente com os clientes garantindo a integração dos dados de entrada e saída e auxiliando os clientes na configuração de acessos, suporte em SQL e validação dos dados antes da integração.

Esse é um desafio para quem tem:

  1. SQL intermediário: Capacidade de escrever, revisar e otimizar queries para extração e transformação de dados.
  2. Conhecimento em APIs e automação (desejável): Experiência com consumo de APIs RESTful e scripts para automação de tarefas técnicas.
  3. Boa comunicação: Facilidade para interagir com clientes técnicos e não técnicos, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.
  4. Capacidade analítica: Habilidade para identificar e solucionar problemas de inconsistência ou divergência de dados.
  5. Organização e gestão de tarefas: Capacidade de priorizar demandas e gerenciar múltiplos clientes simultaneamente.
  6. Agilidade e poder de persuasão: Capacidade de negociar com os clientes e stakeholders, em defesa das necessidades e desejos dos clientes sem esquecer das necessidades da empresa.

Será legal se você tiver:

  1. Conhecimento no segmento de Varejo.
  2. Ter trabalhado com ERPs.
  3. Experiência com integrações de dados: Conhecimento sobre bancos de dados relacionais e processos ETL.
  4. Conhecimento em ferramentas no code como Zapier, n8n.
  5. Conhecimento em ferramentas de dataviz como Metabase.

Optimize global logistics network efficiency and effectiveness through capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse engineering.   4. Establish and maintain global MHE (Material Handling Equipment), including automation standards and requirements.
  5. Collaborate with cross-functional teams—commercial, operations, planning, logistics, and finance—to align capacity planning efforts with business objectives.
  6. Lead projects and coordinate stakeholder resources for capacity expansion initiatives, such as warehouse expansions, fleet upgrades, or network reconfigurations.
  7. Regularly review and audit logistics capacity and network performance to ensure alignment with business needs.
  8. Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in logistics capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse design.
  9. Provide guidance and support to logistics team members on capacity planning tools, processes, and methodologies.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Supply Chain Management, Statistics, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent or advanced proficiency in English.
  • Logistics Experience:
    • Experience in logistics operations, including transportation, warehousing, and distribution, with a focus on network optimization strategies.
    • Experience designing and optimizing logistics networks, considering costs, lead times, and service levels.
  • Capacity Planning:
    • Experience in demand forecasting and resource optimization within logistics.

  • Network Modeling:

As a Performance Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for designing, planning, testing, and delivering Marketing campaigns while you will define the strategy of each campaign, deep dive into data, and come up with conclusions and propositions. Your work will ultimately allow Upstream to positively impact millions of consumers around the world.

  • Optimization of channels, engagement, and monetization KPIs.
  • Ongoing optimization via segmentation, testing, and user experience improvements.
  • Create reports for accounts, new channels, flows & tests.
  • Provide forecasts, reports, and analyses with conclusions and propositions.

The role will be based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
Job Summary
The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.
As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you'll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's leading products for software operation automation.
In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they're based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.
You'll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical's customers and the Ubuntu Community.
As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
  • Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations
What we are looking for in you
  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
  • A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
  • Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
  • Happy to work within distributed teams
  • Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

English Resume Required.

NinjaOne automates the hardest parts of IT to deliver visibility, security, and control over all endpoints for more than 20,000 customers. The NinjaOne automated endpoint management platform is proven to increase productivity, reduce security risk, and lower costs for IT teams and managed service providers. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and provides free and unlimited onboarding, training, and support. What You’ll Love:

Our flexible working hours with home office options enable you to successfully balance your personal life and your job. Grow personally and together with one of the fastest growing companies globally. Develop your skills through our renowned training platform. Receive competitive compensation. Collaborate with an amazing international workforce.

Oferecemos um ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico, onde você terá liberdade para explorar e inovar, com o suporte de uma equipe altamente qualificada e aberta a novas ideias.

  • Desenvolver arquiteturas robustas e escaláveis sempre tendo em foco os conceitos de MLOps.

  • Conhecimento com bibliotecas de ML (scikit-learn, tensorflow, pytorch);
  • Conhecimento dos conceitos da cultura MLOps e sua importância;
  • Curiosidade, adaptabilidade, colaboração, ownership e comunicação.

Desejável:

  • Experiência com Kubernetes;
  • Conhecimentos de ferramentas de workflow de projetos de ML (DVC, mlflow).

Na Serasa Experian, acreditamos que a diversidade é fundamental para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e inovador, onde todas as pessoas possam trocar experiências e expressar suas ideias. title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
description:
Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include top public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. We are a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and few office-based roles, meeting in person 2-4 times yearly in interesting locations worldwide.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer for our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is ideal for an automation-first senior technologist passionate about Linux, aiming to build a career with Canonical and support those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience in IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code, and a passion for technology, you'll thrive here.

Job Summary

The IS team supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services, serving over 60 million Ubuntu users. As a Senior SRE & Gitops Engineer, you'll drive operations automation in our private and public clouds using open source infrastructure as code tools, CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's automation products. You will also provide feedback to developers to improve product operation at scale, contribute to open source projects, and collaborate across teams.

Responsibilities

  • Lead automation and Gitops initiatives as a technical lead within your team.
  • Align solutions with the IS architecture vision by collaborating with the IS architect.
  • Design and develop services to be offered as products by IS.
  • Advance infrastructure as code practices, increasing automation and process improvements.
  • Automate software operations across clouds, considering distributed system complexities.
  • Maintain operational responsibility for core services, networks, and infrastructure.
  • Enhance troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance monitoring using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch.
  • Support and collaborate with global engineering, operations, and support teams.
  • Focus on larger projects and automation during dedicated development time.
  • Share expertise through design sessions, mentorship, and collaborative work.
  • Handle time-critical escalations responsibly.

Qualifications

  • Experience with hosting architecture driven by infrastructure as code across private and public clouds.
  • Product mindset focused on developing products rather than just solutions.
  • Proficiency in Python, especially with large projects.
  • Experience with Kubernetes or similar container orchestration systems.
  • Proven ability to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls.
  • Familiarity with Linux storage solutions like Ceph and databases.
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers.
  • Deep understanding of cloud computing concepts and technologies.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or related field.
  • Effective communication skills in English via multiple channels.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills from kernel to web, with a collaborative attitude.
  • Willingness to learn quickly and adapt to fast-changing environments.
  • Comfort working within distributed teams.
  • Passion for open source, especially Ubuntu or Debian.

What We Offer

Competitive global compensation, annual reviews, performance bonuses, and benefits aligned with our values. Additional perks include:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.
  • USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget.
  • Recognition rewards, annual leave, parental leave, wellness programs, and travel opportunities.

About Canonical

Canonical pioneers open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We hire globally, uphold high standards, and foster a discrimination-free workplace. Working here challenges you to think differently, learn continually, and excel.

Position Summary:

The digital workplace head is responsible for the strategy and management of digital workplace technologies and services, ensuring a seamless digital employee experience (DEX). This role covers all functions of the digital workplace, including the service desk management, budgeting, and IT asset management (hardware and software), enhancing digital dexterity, and driving positive business outcomes, while maintaining compliance with SOX and ITGC controls.

Main responsibilities:

  • Reporting to Infrastructure Head and partner with the CIO/CTO, human resources, facilities and other IT and business leaders to set the strategic direction of the digital workplace and DEX improvements.
  • Lead the digital workplace operations team focused on fulfilling (telephony included) end-user support and service requests, including the IT service desk, the VIP and desktop support, A/V support, Active Directory, IT services catalogue and IT asset management (hardware & software) inventory.
  • Manage the annual budget for operating and capital expenditures and govern digital workplace technology usage, standards, and licensing to align with IT and company objectives while optimizing costs and enforcing data policies.
  • Contract administration including management of service level for services in the scope including licensing expiration, renewal with different services providers and procurement team.
  • Lead the development, publication and maintenance of the corporate IT catalogue of product and services and its roadmap aligned with business requirements and IT leaders.
  • Provide IT leaders and business with a consolidated overview of IT Service Support KPIs (support tickets and service requests) submitted by the business area, ensuring adherence to SLAs (Service Level Agreements).
  • Champion the modernization of workforce technology and services to enable new ways of working and digital transformation, while demonstrating digital dexterity and fostering a culture of workforce digital dexterity by leading adoption, enablement, and influence to achieve digital business goals.
  • Partner with HR to understand employees’ current challenges, new roles, demographic changes, mobility, hybrid work and more, incorporating this knowledge into digital workplace planning, while utilizing organizational change management best practices to drive technology adoption.
  • Partner with corporate real estate/facilities to create a smart workplace that supports hybrid and remote workers as much as onsite workers.
  • Collaborate with colleagues in internal communications to communicate how digital workplace applications benefit employees through enablement campaigns and measurement of customer satisfaction and eNPS.
  • Work with IT security and risk management to ensure that digital workplace technologies comply with corporate policies and industry standards.
  • Responsible for SOX and ITGC controls within the digital workplace, including the polices creation or update ensuring flawless execution and developing action plans for improvements when necessary.


Main requirements:

  • (5+) years managing IT systems, processes and vendors.
  • (5+) years of leading digital workplace team and processes including external service desk services
  • English mandatory
  • Experience with vendor governance, KPI Management, including demonstrated success in conducting RFPs and vendor service transitions.
  • Proven financial management skills with operational budget tasks.
  • Awareness of ways to measure Digital Experience and satisfaction.
  • Working knowledge of IT frameworks such as ITIL, including key processes – knowledge, incident, change, service request and major-incident management.
  • Proven ability to manage rapidly changing business priorities, processes and technologies.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of digital workplace applications.

We see our way of working as a differentiator, which contributes to retain the best team, to establish long-term relationships with clients, to expand to other countries, and to attract investors and partners who allow us to generate superior returns:

title: Associate Director, Sales
description:
Join to apply for the Associate Director, Sales role at Shure Incorporated .

We are seeking a dynamic, experienced Associate Director, Sales to lead Shure’s sales strategy across South America, overseeing the Brazil-based Channel Marketing and Customer Experience teams serving Latin America. The role involves driving revenue growth through channel partnerships, developing go-to-market strategies, strengthening partner engagement, and aligning with Shure’s brand and business objectives. It also includes shaping long-term goals, uncovering new opportunities, and enhancing the end-user experience.

If you have a strong background in sales and marketing leadership, a deep understanding of the Latin American channel ecosystem, and a proven ability to build collaborative relationships that drive customer success, apply now!

Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese is required. This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil.

Responsibilities

  1. Lead the South America sales organization, managing sales performance, growth targets, and margin improvements. Develop and implement strategic plans to exceed sales targets across all product lines.
  2. Provide leadership to the Sales, Channel Marketing, and Customer Experience teams, ensuring alignment, accountability, and high performance. Set goals, coach team members, and foster a culture of innovation and professional growth.
  3. Manage strategic channel accounts, focusing on growth, value creation, and customer journey improvements. Build long-term relationships with top partners and ensure strategic alignment.
  4. Oversee regional channel marketing and customer engagement initiatives in collaboration with the Brazil-based team supporting Latin America. Ensure programs are effective and aligned with sales objectives, contributing to partner enablement and customer success.
  5. Develop and execute regional channel sales plans with cross-functional teams, identifying gaps and opportunities to increase market penetration and partner performance.
  6. Support regional promotions, product launches, events, and training programs in collaboration with internal teams like product marketing, global accounts, and operations.
  7. Represent the voice of Latin American channel partners internally, providing strategic input on global and regional initiatives. Lead regional projects supporting business transformation.
  8. Manage budgeting and forecasting for regional teams, ensuring alignment with business goals and responsible financial management.
  9. Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.
  • 10–12 years of experience in sales and/or channel leadership.
  • 7+ years managing teams and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Knowledge of the professional audio or AV industry is preferred.
  • Experience working with Latin American channel ecosystems.
  • Ability to manage complexity, execute strategies, and lead in a matrix organization.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or similar CRM tools.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills.
  • Ability to inspire and motivate diverse teams.
  • Willingness to travel up to 75%.
  • Languages: Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

Who We Are

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide. Founded in 1925, we are a leading manufacturer of audio equipment, known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless systems, and more. We foster an inclusive culture, offering flexible work arrangements and opportunities for all.

Headquartered in the United States, we have over 35 regional offices, engineering hubs, and manufacturing facilities across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

The Mix Matters

If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about this role and share our values, we encourage you to apply. We are committed to an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible workplace.

Descrição:

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Inspeções e Auditorias de Segurança

• Realizar inspeções periódicas nas instalações da empresa para identificar riscos e oportunidades de melhoria.

• Conduzir auditorias internas e externas em conformidade com as Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) e demais legislações aplicáveis.

• Acompanhar as condições de trabalho, instalações, máquinas e equipamentos, promovendo melhorias contínuas nas práticas de segurança.

2. Gestão e Implementação de Normas de Segurança

• Garantir o cumprimento das normas legais e internas de segurança do trabalho, por meio da elaboração, revisão e atualização de procedimentos.

• Supervisionar e garantir o uso correto dos Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e Coletiva (EPCs), orientando os colaboradores quanto à sua utilização.

3. Treinamentos e Conscientização

• Planejar e realizar treinamentos periódicos de segurança, primeiros socorros, combate a incêndios, manuseio de EPIs e operação segura de máquinas.

• Promover campanhas e ações de conscientização voltadas à cultura de prevenção de acidentes.

• Conduzir simulados de evacuação e resposta a emergências.

4. Investigação de Acidentes e Incidentes

• Investigar acidentes e quase acidentes, identificando causas raízes e elaborando planos de ação corretiva e preventiva.

• Emitir relatórios técnicos com análises e indicadores de desempenho em segurança.

5. Gestão de Documentação e Relatórios

• Manter atualizados os registros legais e operacionais de segurança do trabalho: controle de EPIs, treinamentos, PPRA/PGR, PCMSO, LTCAT, CAT, entre outros.

• Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de SST para acompanhamento estratégico da área.

6. Gestão de Riscos Ambientais e Ocupacionais

• Identificar, avaliar e controlar riscos ambientais e ocupacionais, conforme legislação vigente.

• Apoiar ações de controle de substâncias químicas, descarte de resíduos e demais práticas de segurança ambiental.

7. Gestão de Terceiros e Prestadores de Serviços

• Acompanhar e garantir que os terceiros cumpram os requisitos legais e internos de segurança durante suas atividades na empresa.

• Elaborar, revisar e validar documentação de segurança exigida de terceiros (como PCMSO, PGR, ASO, treinamentos e permissões de trabalho).

• Promover integração e treinamentos específicos de segurança para terceiros, reforçando o alinhamento com a cultura da empresa.

8. Gestão do AVCB (Auto de Vistoria do Corpo de Bombeiros)

• Gerir o processo de obtenção, renovação e manutenção do AVCB da empresa.

• Coordenar as adequações necessárias para atendimento às exigências do Corpo de Bombeiros, como sistemas de combate a incêndios, sinalizações e rotas de fuga.

• Manter controle rigoroso sobre a validade e documentação de licenças relacionadas à segurança contra incêndio.

9. Gestão do eSocial – Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho (SST)

• Garantir o correto preenchimento e envio das informações de SST no eSocial, dentro dos prazos legais.

• Trabalhar em conjunto com o RH para atualização dos eventos de segurança e saúde ocupacional.

• Controlar e registrar eventos como acidentes de trabalho, exames médicos e treinamentos obrigatórios no sistema.

10. Apoio em Projetos de Segurança e Melhoria Contínua

• Participar da implementação de projetos e soluções voltadas à melhoria da segurança no ambiente de trabalho.

• Atuar de forma consultiva com outras áreas, promovendo a integração da segurança com os processos produtivos e administrativos.

11. Gestão Patrimonial e Operacional de Serviços Terceirizados

• Monitorar e controlar a integridade do patrimônio da empresa, incluindo instalações, equipamentos e áreas comuns.

• Supervisionar os serviços terceirizados de portaria, vigilância, jardinagem e limpeza, assegurando o cumprimento de cronogramas, padrões de qualidade e normas de segurança.

• Garantir que os prestadores de serviços patrimoniais estejam devidamente documentados, treinados e integrados às políticas da empresa.

• Atuar na melhoria contínua dos serviços terceirizados, propondo ajustes contratuais, treinamentos ou reestruturações quando necessário.

• Acompanhar e auditar o uso e conservação de áreas comuns, zelando pela ordem, segurança e limpeza do ambiente de trabalho.


Requisitos:

Requisitos

• Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho (com registro ativo).

• Experiência anterior na função, preferencialmente no setor industrial.

• Conhecimento aprofundado das NRs e da legislação vigente.

• Experiência comprovada em gestão de terceiros e controle documental de prestadores de serviços.

• Vivência em gestão de riscos ambientais e ocupacionais.

• Domínio da plataforma eSocial, com foco nos eventos de SST.

• Experiência na gestão do AVCB e rotinas de segurança contra incêndio.

• Vivência com gestão patrimonial (limpeza, vigilância, portaria, manutenção predial).

• Habilidade para ministrar treinamentos, elaborar relatórios técnicos e conduzir investigações.

Poucas indústrias passaram por uma revolução tão grande na pandemia da COVID-19 como a do delivery de supermercado. Ao mesmo tempo que muitas empresas consolidadas cresceram ainda mais nesse período, elas ainda não conseguiam entregar uma boa experiência para seus clientes.
E nós sabíamos que o cliente merecia mais. Por isso, resolvemos desenvolver um modelo do zero, com foco total nas pessoas e com a ambição de uma startup que busca a liderança de mercado!
Aí criamos a Daki. :)
Somos o app de delivery mais rápido do Brasil. Entregamos mais de 1000 produtos na sua porta em minutos! Simples, intuitivo e super rápido - para você ter tempo de desfrutar o melhor da sua vida sem precisar perder tempo indo ao supermercado.
Nossos produtos foram cuidadosamente selecionados para atender aos prazeres do dia-a-dia e também às necessidades de uma vida agitada. Temos da cerveja gelada ao carregador de celular, e estamos sempre à procura de inovações que entreguem experiências ainda melhores para a nossa exigente clientela.
Estamos em busca de pessoas que compartilhem essa visão de um mundo mais simples, tecnológico e com foco no cliente, e também que transbordem energia para tirar esse sonho do papel. Se você se identificou, esse é um bom sinal!

Nossos valores:
Na Daki, acreditamos que é possível revolucionar o mercado sem abrir mão do que é mais importante: as pessoas.
Cuidar de você e do outro é essencial para manter um ambiente de trabalho leve, onde todos se sintam seguros, física e psicologicamente.
Colaborar é a chave para o sucesso. Estamos sempre atentos às necessidades e objetivos de todos, porque sabemos que o nosso propósito final é comum: encantar nossos clientes!
Entregar do Jeito Certo significa agir com integridade e ética, enfrentando desafios de frente para garantir a melhor qualidade, experiência e valor em tudo o que fazemos.
Mas não queremos apenas atender expectativas, queremos Surpreender. Ir além do esperado e fazer tudo parecer mágica faz parte do nosso DNA.
Inovar está no nosso dia a dia. Para isso, estamos sempre dispostos a Questionar. Se existe uma forma melhor e mais eficiente, nós vamos atrás dela. Sempre com base em dados e com uma abordagem estruturada para propor mudanças que façam a diferença.
E, claro, também precisamos Curtir o caminho. Celebramos cada conquista – das pequenas até as grandes – com brilho nos olhos, aprendendo com os erros e criando espaço para aquilo que mais importa na vida.
Se você se identifica com essa forma de trabalhar e viver, então você encontrou o seu lugar.

title: Projetista
description:
Olá, somos a Gralha Azul Portas, Madeiras e ACM Premium Door. Nascemos em 1991 e desde 2020 estamos em pleno crescimento e evolução. Somos uma empresa dinâmica, que adora mudanças e promove melhorias em nossos processos. Aqui, o Cliente é a prioridade número um e fazemos nosso melhor por ele. Se você é dinâmico, gosta de desafios novos e adora mudanças, você vai se identificar com nossa cultura!

O Projetista é responsável pelo desenvolvimento de novos produtos, garantindo que eles sejam funcionais e viáveis, tanto do ponto de vista técnico quanto econômico. Este profissional trabalha diretamente na concepção e design de produtos, assegurando que todas as especificações sejam atendidas e que os produtos cumpram com os padrões de qualidade exigidos. O Projetista também acompanha de perto o processo de produção, garantindo que os produtos sejam fabricados de acordo com o projeto e funcionem perfeitamente.

Além do desenvolvimento de novos produtos, o Projetista desempenha um papel essencial na melhoria contínua dos processos produtivos. Ele desenvolve peças e soluções técnicas que otimizam a produção, visando aumentar a eficiência e reduzir custos. Este profissional deve ter um forte conhecimento técnico, habilidades em design e a capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente, sem a necessidade de gerenciar uma equipe.

Atividades pertinentes ao cargo:

  1. Desenvolver novos produtos desde a concepção até a implementação, garantindo a funcionalidade e viabilidade técnica.
  2. Elaborar e revisar projetos técnicos e especificações dos produtos.
  3. Acompanhar a produção dos produtos, assegurando que sejam fabricados conforme o projeto e atendam aos padrões de qualidade.
  4. Desenvolver peças e soluções técnicas para a melhoria dos processos produtivos dos setores.
  5. Colaborar com outros departamentos, como produção e qualidade, para garantir a integração e eficiência dos projetos.
  6. Realizar testes de funcionamento dos produtos, identificando e solucionando possíveis problemas.
  7. Fazer testes e simulações práticas e computacionais dos produtos, para garantir a integridade dos mesmos.
  8. Detalhar os projetos para os clientes, incluindo a renderização final dos produtos.
  9. Realizar simulações de viabilidade estrutural para garantir a segurança e eficácia dos produtos.
  10. Dimensionar materiais e realizar o levantamento de custos para os projetos.
  11. Projetar o tempo necessário para a produção de cada produto, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos.
  12. Garantir que todos os produtos estejam em conformidade com as normas e regulamentações aplicáveis.
  13. Atualizar-se constantemente sobre novas tecnologias e métodos de engenharia para aplicar nos projetos.
  14. Participar de reuniões técnicas para discutir o andamento dos projetos e propor melhorias.
  15. Fornecer suporte técnico durante todas as fases do desenvolvimento do produto.
  16. Sistema SolidWorks deve ser Avançado.

Nossos Benefícios:

  1. Nossos benefícios de VT e VR são creditados no cartão Swile Benefícios, onde o colaborador tem mais flexibilidade para utilização em vários locais que utilizam bandeira Mastercard.
  2. Convênio Odontológico DentalUni com 222 procedimentos à sua disposição.

  • Innovative Problem-Solving Skills: The ability to tackle complex challenges in a non-linear fashion is essential. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.
  • Strong Communication Skills:Exceptional writing and verbal communication abilities, with proficiency in creating impactful and visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

title: Auditor externo
description:
O grupo líder mundial em Teste, Inspeção e Certificação, está com vagas de emprego abertas para o Projeto 2025 em Passo Fundo e região.

A vaga é para atuar como auditor agrícola em um dos maiores projetos da empresa a nível nacional, uma oportunidade para contribuir com o desenvolvimento da qualidade no agronegócio nacional. Não é necessário experiência prévia. Os selecionados passarão por imersão no Projeto, recebendo treinamento sobre as atividades e uso dos sistemas de inspeção, a primeira fase de seleção é realizada integralmente online.

Buscamos profissionais que incorporem nossos valores, não têm medo de desafios, busquem inovar, experimentar e se aprimorar rapidamente. Nosso objetivo é contratar e reter os indivíduos mais brilhantes, oferecendo crescimento profissional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento em toda a carreira. Se é você, adoraríamos conversar.

Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos buscando Auditores Agrícolas que contribuirão com atividades de coleta de dados através do acompanhamento de testes transgênicos em pontos de recebimento de soja (PDR's) em silos, armazéns e cooperativas. Nossa missão é oferecer serviços e soluções inovadoras para garantir que os ativos, produtos e processos de nossos mais de 400 mil clientes atendam a padrões e regulamentos em termos de qualidade, saúde, segurança, proteção ambiental e responsabilidade social.

Atividades:

  1. Garantir execução das metodologias;
  2. Revisão das informações coletadas em campo;
  3. Comunicação tempestiva com os líderes alinhamento das divergências encontradas;
  4. Verificação de formulários e validação dos dados coletados em campo;
  5. Disponibilidade total de horários (inclusive aos finais de semana);
  6. Disponibilidade para viagens;
  7. CNH B ativa (preferencialmente, não obrigatório);
  8. Ensino médio completo;
  9. Facilidade em manuseio de tecnologias (tablets e smartphone);
  10. Ética, responsabilidade, comprometimento, organização.

Remuneração: valor R$ 1.750,00 + benefício semanal de R$ 445,00 + bonificação mensal de R$ 200,00 - Contratação CLT (temporário de até 6 meses).

As vagas são temporárias, para atuação nos estados do Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Em caso de viagens a empresa custeia todas as despesas: deslocamento entre as cidades de origem e de atuação, hospedagem, transporte, alimentação, lavanderia, internet.

Candidatos contratados que se destacarem em suas funções poderão ser efetivados em diferentes cargos e setores dentro da empresa, além de terem prioridade de contratação em outros projetos pontuais da divisão de Agronegócios.

A empresa desempenha papel fundamental para o fortalecimento do setor, inspecionando anualmente, mais de 30% dos grãos produzidos no país e mais de 50% do volume exportado nos principais portos brasileiros.

title: Senior Category Manager- 3P LATAM, External Fulfillment LATAM
description:
Senior Category Manager- 3P LATAM, External Fulfillment LATAM

We are seeking a talented Senior Category Manager to play an instrumental role in building strategic third-party external fulfillment relationships to supplement Amazon fulfillment and storage capacity. The role will interface with end to end fulfillment partners creating strategic connections to meet network requirements on an annual basis. This role will be external facing to Third Party Logstics (3PL) fulfillment providers and will act as a liaison to internal Amazon Fulfillment Network (AFN) stakeholders.
As a Senior Category Manager, you will create and own the strategic relationship with 3PL providers and senior internal stakeholders. You will ensure continuity of supply by developing 3PLs to service every instance of the fulfillment network from storage to fulfillment and in some instances transportation. You will develop holistic solutions with 3PL to meet topology, service, customer experience, speed, flexibility, and ultimately cost to serve requirements. You will drive key sourcing activities in collaboration with network partners ensuring network resiliency. This role will require a level of innovation to solve on behalf of our customers, consistently breaking perceived solution constraints
We are seeking a leader with procurement and operations experience to build a network of strategically sourced 3PL solutions capable of meeting Amazon network requirements. The position will work and partner with multiple teams to develop and execute category sourcing strategies and processes, deliver savings and improve productivity.
Key job responsibilities
- Build and create a 3PL EF procurement team creating 3PL solutions solving for network capacity
- Build a resilient 3PL supplier ecosystem creating resiliency, flexibility, and incremental capacity when required
- Identify, develop and deliver long term sourcing strategies while leading sourcing initiatives with cross-functional teams
- Drive the decision-making process with senior leadership to improve 3PL EF category management.
- Drive commercial relationships with suppliers, with a principal objective of achieving Amazon service and customer experience with improved cost and performance
- Lead supplier performance management; including improving sustainability and social responsibility
- Coordinate and collaborate with operational teams to deploy and manage the implementation of your defined strategies.
~25% travel including occasional international travel

A day in the life
- Earn the trust of key stakeholders driving alignment with the business
- Drive and execute complex sourcing activities in cooperation with cross-functional teams
- Creatively problem solve and deliver complete market solutions
- Develop a resilient, fast paced, flexible supplier ecosystem capable of delivering at or above the speed of the business
- Gather business needs and elaborate the most optimal sourcing strategy to secure on timely manner the capacity, minimizing Total Cost of Ownership and risk
- Leverage existing procurement resources to benefit our internal customers
- Own commercial relationship with third-party logistic providers
About the team
GPO 3PL External Fulfillment procurement is focused on delivering solutions and services to the AFN by building a strong 3PL network supplier base. Our team aims to fulfill at 1P speed, service and customer experience while providing advantages in cost and flexibility. Our team strives to be THE control tower for 3PL EF procurement support to our stakeholders. We continue to innovate and find ways to move faster and more efficiently to deliver capacity for Amazon Customer fulfillment network.
Key stakeholders include various teams within Network Planning, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, Legal and others.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor of Science degree
- +5 years of Direct Procurement
- +2 years of Operations
- Fluent in Brazilian Portuguese, both written and oral
- Fluent in English, both written and oral

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- MBA
- Exceptional communication skills
- Exceptional problem solving skills

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description:
Our Mission is to be able to say - “Anyone in the World below $15M should fire their Agency tomorrow as nobody can beat this Value & Service at this Price”

We’re seeking a Results-Driven & Experienced Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist to join our team.

The Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist at Common Thread Collective (CTC) plays a critical role in driving client success. You will lead the development of accurate strategic forecasts that guide our clients toward their goals, ensuring seamless execution of strategies that translate forecasts into measurable growth. Your actions and decisions consistently resonate with the core values of CTC Global, serving as a beacon for these principles. At CTC, your trained expertise is invaluable, covering the entire spectrum of CTC’s Strategic Forecasting methods and the foundational principles of media acquisition.

Beyond strategic planning, you are an active partner in client growth, maintaining transparent communication about the actions taken and performance relative to forecasts. This engagement strengthens relationships and ensures that CTC’s clients have a clear roadmap to success while guiding them through the complexities of media acquisition and strategy.

You stand as a representative and zealous advocate for CTC's unique approach to media acquisition and its accompanying tools.
As a Senior Ecommerce Growth Strategist, you set a high standard. People know that when you are involved, execution at the highest level is guaranteed.

You see your goals as barriers to break through and take great pride in giving your all. We value the mantra of “Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me” meaning that you can see things through to the end!

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible Company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing Our mission, we organize all of our decisions—from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money—in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone.

They're challenging. In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

AUTODIDACT

  • Naturally curious and an autodidact, able to absorb information quickly and effectively.
  • Your openness to both offer and embrace feedback as an opportunity for growth.
  • Demonstrates resourcefulness, and independently refines your skills without being prompted.
  • Thrives in a self-managed environment, showing autonomy, initiative, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

  • Embodies a character that inspires pride in both personal and professional associations.
  • Consistently honest, with the courage to acknowledge and communicate hard truths.
  • Displays a high level of self-awareness, taking full ownership of outcomes.
  • Values constructive feedback and integrates it.

COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

  • Performs at their best when it matters most.
  • Demonstrates an unyielding determination to get things done.
  • Adapts to changing circumstances, recognizing that true success is about exceeding what is required.
  • Possesses a deep passion for their work, using creativity and resilience to overcome any hurdle.

What Success Looks Like

NECESSARY SKILLS

TRAINING PERIOD

  • Be willing to put in the hard work required.
  • Being ready for this to be the hardest job you have ever worked.
  • The ability to take feedback and implement it fast.
  • Finish the work to the fullest with quality and on time.
  • Perseverance.
  • Remember and learn from the repetitive doing of the exercises.

ONBOARDING

  • Align with the team and contribute to the team called Brain Trust for Ideas across clients.
  • Manage, align & work with the team members of your pod including Google strategist, Creative Strategist, and Email Strategist.
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail.
  • Upkeep of data integrity of your clients across Statlas.
  • Be responsible for the execution of the Prophet system for your clients.
  • Building a Growth Forecast for your clients.
  • The Daily Execution and Actualisation vs the Forecast.

ENSURING AND HOLDING THE STANDARD OF QUALITY OF WORK

  • Ensuring you are within a 5% Delta to the Forecast.
  • Ensuring daily alignment with the client vs the forecast & strategy.
  • Ensuring all the work is delivered based on the timeline assigned with optimal quality & attention to detail.

Client Communication

  • You are a champion of communication, ensuring the client is aligned on the Growth Map goals and next steps.
  • Responsible for sending daily performance updates to the client.
  • Ensure alignment across Strategy and Forecast with the client.
  • Providing weekly updates on the Weekly Strategy Call.

CONTRIBUTING BACK

  • Contributing your learnings back to the system for feedback and continuous improvement.
  • Contributing & collaborating in ideas and learning across teams.
  • Contributing to ideas and learning in future company content production.

NEXT-LEVEL SKILLS

Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English, with a proven ability to communicate persuasively.
  • Skilled in crafting thoughtful, empathetic client messaging.
  • Strong presentation skills, capable of delivering compelling presentations.
  • Strong raw talent for data analysis, with an eagerness to learn and improve.
  • Familiarity with data tools, including Google Sheets.

Past Experience

Critical Thinking

  • Ability to approach challenges with structured thinking.
  • Naturally adept at dissecting issues and proposing practical solutions.

Impact

  • Highly motivated and hardworking, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.

Results

You will merge the Finance and Marketing sides of a business to build a forecasted strategy to help the business achieve its goal.

  • Achieve certification and confidence in our ideology by the end of training.

  • Meet all deadlines and budget requirements.

DOMAIN

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way.

ORIENTATION

About Digibee

Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. Rather than require specialized integration experts, Digibee lets every developer quickly build, test, deploy, govern, and monitor integrations across on-premise and cloud environments using a simple but powerful low-code interface.

Founded in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2017 and headquartered in Weston, Florida, our team is widely distributed throughout the Americas. In May of 2023, Digibee closed a Series B funding round of $60 million that is intended to drive our expansion in the United States.

About the role

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of our integration technology and extend its functionalities. You will be responsible for both technical and managerial leadership, driving innovation and performance while ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

On a typical day, you will…

Technical Leadership

  • Lead the team responsible for the development and maintenance of our microservices-based core integration engine.
  • Lead the team focused on extending the engine capabilities through the development of connectors, triggers, and other add-ons.
  • Propose technical hypotheses and drive R&D efforts to improve system capabilities.
  • Ensure proper architecture for a highly distributed system.
  • Work closely with the technical team, participating in code reviews, discussions, and validating the use of best practices.

High-Performance Focus

This position is onsite at our São Paulo, Brazil office.
