  • Partner with internal technical teams (product management, engineering, dev ops, and cloud ops) to resolve problems with configuration/code, software bugs, performance, and system failures.
  • Document the knowledge base of recurring issues. Take part in improving the documentation (after customer feedback) and/or fixing bugs to expedite the resolution of customer issues and to avoid long waiting times for fixes from the Dev team.

  • Associate's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent in English.
  • At least 2 years of experience in Technical Support or Software Development.
  • Ability to learn with an interest and aptitude for technology.
  • Familiarity with .NET programming or equivalent language experience.
  • Ability to work through a problem effectively and provide a solution.
  • Ability to work in a flexible and fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts both in writing and verbally.

  • Solid technical background in development:
    • Java.
    • JavaScript: Nuxeo uses the Polymer framework.
    • Database: MongoDB and/or PostgreSQL (Oracle and MS SQL Server).
    • Docker and Kubernetes technologies.
    • Metrics analysis.

Em 2013, iniciou a montagem de guindastes RT (rough terrain) e rolos compactadores em sua unidade de fabricação. No final de 2017, inaugurou instalações em Jacareí/SP. A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias para oferecer produtos e serviços de pós-venda em todo o Brasil.

Solutions Specialist LATAM (CAD/BIM software)

Bricsys, part of Hexagon, is a global technology company creating innovative Computer Aided Design software for worldwide markets. Our products enable the world’s most innovative companies to streamline complex design workflows every day. Our people are active in 80 countries, and our software is available in fifteen languages. As a committed long-term business partner, we are investing in the future by expanding our team across the LATAM region. The success of our customers and partners is key to us, and having local experts available plays an important role.

We are currently looking for an experienced Solutions Specialist to join our LATAM Presales team.

As a Solutions Specialist at Bricsys, you will play a pivotal role in driving sales success in the LATAM region by providing advanced technical expertise and support during the sales process.

You will collaborate closely with our regional (pre)sales team and work with our channel partners in the region to understand client needs, demonstrate product capabilities, and develop tailored solutions that align with customer requirements.

The role is offered on a regular, full-time employment contract basis and can be performed remotely in Brazil.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Align with key customer stakeholders to secure business and technical closure of the proposed Bricsys solution.
  • Provide consultancy and best practices for project implementation.
  • Develop and maintain trusted working relationships with Bricsys Reseller Network & Territory Sales.
  • Communicate and materialize clients’ needs with customized solutions.
  • Polish relationships with clients, partners, vendors, and external parties.
  • Conduct sales & channel enablement, including industry and/or product sales demonstrations.
  • Establish and maintain industry leadership through competitive studies and in-depth knowledge of technologies impacting customers & global technology marketplace.
  • Establish workflow and framework for new technology implementation.
  • Manage training and workshops for BIM/VDC related software.

We are looking for:

Skills:

  • Clear passion and commitment to be an innovator.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a consultative approach to sales.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a remote team environment.
  • Understanding of how to define BIM scope, integrate workflow processes, set up standards, manage key stakeholders, and monitor performance.
  • Ability to lead the production and quality assurance processes.
  • Ability to plan and optimize CAD technology implementation.
  • Ability to support pre-sales activities and research, propose and evaluate the latest CAD and BIM technology.

Knowledge:

  • Extensive knowledge of CAD/BIM technology.
  • Extensive knowledge of AEC, BIM and/or Manufacturing sectors in the region and their challenges.
  • Strong knowledge of channel partner/reseller model and developing channel partner relationships.

Experience:

  • 10+ years' professional experience in roles combining technical capabilities and commercial skills, such as Principal Consultant, Implementation Manager, Solution Architect, Practice Manager, Technical Presales Consultant, Application Engineer, or similar.
  • Previous hands-on user experience with CAD/BIM solutions demonstrating a strong understanding of their applications and functionalities.
  • Demonstrable experience researching, evaluating, analyzing, and delivering CAD technology.
  • Demonstrable experience in content development and delivery of CAD software demos, consultancy, workshops, and training.
  • Demonstrable experience establishing BIM workflows and frameworks for new technology implementations.

Education & Other Qualifications:

  • Preferred qualifications in either Architecture, Building Management, or Engineering.
  • Proficiency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Availability to travel in the region as needed for client and partner engagements, as well as industry events.

If you are a passionate and driven professional, we invite you to join our team at Bricsys. This represents an excellent opportunity for the right candidate to join a fast-paced, exciting company on a mission to delight our customers and deliver significant growth.

Interested? We look forward to hearing from you!

Finance at TRACTIAN

The Finance team at TRACTIAN is responsible for managing the company’s financial health and ensuring sustainable growth. This team oversees financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and analysis, ensuring that all departments have the resources they need to operate efficiently. They also manage financial reporting and compliance, working closely with other departments to ensure alignment with the company’s strategic goals. Finance is key to driving profitability, managing cash flow, and ensuring that TRACTIAN maintains a healthy financial foundation as it scales.

What you'll do

As a Senior FP&A Analyst, you will lead financial planning, forecasting, and reporting processes to provide strategic insights that support key business decisions. Working closely with senior management, you will deliver actionable financial data, improve forecasting accuracy, and drive financial performance across the organization. This role requires strong analytical skills, a deep understanding of financial metrics, and the ability to communicate complex financial concepts clearly to non-financial stakeholders.

A Pessoa Operadora de Caixa desempenha um papel crucial na experiência do cliente e na eficiência financeira da empresa. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem registrar compras, calcular valores, receber pagamentos em dinheiro, cartões ou outros meios, emitir recibos e fornecer troco, se necessário.   • Participar do inventário, quando convocado;
  • Executar corretamente o procedimento de entrega anotando com atenção os dados referentes ao endereço, numeração de caixas e lacres.

Descrição e Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolve orçamentos preliminares e executivos, conforme processos de orçamentação técnicos e normativos cabíveis ao segmento da construção civil, com a utilização de Sistemas Integrados (ERP’s), e Software’s específicos a área;
  • Confere e aprova os levantamentos quantitativos realizados por Terceirizados (PJ), em formato de documento .xlsx (MS Excel), para seu lançamento em Planilha Orçamentária;
  • Elabora e mantém o cadastro de insumos atualizados para orçamentação, no sistema integrado (ERP), para seu uso no desenvolvimento do Orçamento Executivo.
  • Elabora e mantém o cadastro de composições de preços unitários (sérvios), no sistema integrado (ERP), para seu uso no desenvolvimento do Orçamento Executivo.
  • Desenvolve a estrutura analítica de projetos seguindo os critérios de orçamentação da área, para implantação da Planilha Orçamentária no Sistema Integrado (ERP);
  • Lança a Planilha Orçamentária no Sistema Integrado (ERP), incluindo quantitativos levantados, composições de preços unitários, para conclusão da Orçamentação do Empreendimento;
  • Emiti e avalia as curvas padrões ABC (materiais, serviços, equipamentos e mão-de-obra), pelo Sistema Integrado (ERP), para análise do Orçamento Executivo, e sua aprovação;
  • Elabora e padroniza procedimentos técnicos para Orçamentação, pela construção de planilhas orçamentárias, cadastros de insumos, composições e serviços, além de relatórios orçamentários inerentes;
  • Elabora Instruções de Trabalho e Manual Técnico, para as atividades relacionadas a Orçamentação;
  • Analisa Propostas Técnicas e Comerciais, assim como referências de custos unitários mercadológicos;
  • Realiza Estudos de Viabilidade Técnica e Econômica;
  • Elabora e Apresenta análises comparativas e evolutivas, com indicadores, sobre Orçamentos Executivos e Preliminares;
  • Realiza visitas técnicas em Obras para acompanhamento da Aderência do Orçamento Executivo as Atividades e processos de Construção aplicados, seguindo com o desenvolvimento de relatórios gerenciais e indicadores, com o objetivo de identificar desvios, e buscar mitigações destes;
  • Elabora e implanta processos que possibilitem a retroalimentação de informações sobre os Orçamentos desenvolvidos, pelas obras em execução;
  • Ministra treinamentos relacionados as atividades de Orçamentação;
  • Participa de reuniões gerenciais e apresenta relatórios periódicos sobre as atividades e resultados desenvolvidos.

Requisitos

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Civil ou Produção / Formação Técnica em Edificações.

Diferencial: Vivência em canteiros de Obras ou Atividades corporativas empresariais em Construtoras (escritório).

Sobre a empresa

Somos uma empresa mineira com atuação no mercado imobiliário, desenvolvendo e construindo empreendimentos residenciais e comerciais, com o foco maior nos projetos enquadrados no programa Casa Verde e Amarela. No mercado há mais de 18 anos, possuímos um portfólio com mais de 30 mil imóveis entregues e em desenvolvimento, com presença nacional em mais de 20 cidades de 8 estados brasileiros, prezando sempre pela qualidade e excelência dos seus produtos.

Estamos presentes nos estados de Minas Gerais, Pará, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo, com projetos de expansão em Espírito Santo e Rio Grande do Sul.

Contamos com profissionais experientes que cuidam com muita dedicação de cada etapa dos processos internos. Possuímos em nosso portfólio, diversos projetos, os quais demonstram a capacidade técnica e o compromisso com a busca constante pela satisfação dos nossos clientes.

Desde a concepção ao término de um empreendimento, cada etapa é realizada com o maior empenho, sempre buscando ainda mais aperfeiçoamento. Com projetos inteligentes e de estilo próprio - nossas marcas registradas, os empreendimentos são bem planejados e acompanhados de perto por nossos clientes e por toda a equipe.

Oferecemos aos nossos clientes, qualidade de vida, segurança e facilidade de pagamento. Sempre em constante processo de evolução

Resumo da Posição:

Estamos em busca de um profissional para vaga de Analista Contábil Sênior para suprir a frente de trabalho de Orçamento e Planejamento . O profissional será responsável por coletar informações das áreas operacionais para planejamento anual, provisões e acompanhamento de resultados. Elaborar orçamentos e projeções de curto e longo prazo, e participar na definição de metas. Fornecer análises para apoio à tomada de decisões estratégicas e elaboração de relatórios para a alta gestão. Acompanhar indicadores chave de desempenho (KPIs) e garantir serviços e fluxos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  1. Desenvolver e revisar o orçamento anual: Participar da elaboração do orçamento da empresa, considerando projeções de receitas, custos e despesas, alinhados com a estratégia e metas da organização.
  2. Acompanhamento do desempenho orçamentário: Monitorar e analisar o desempenho real versus o orçamento, identificando variações significativas e trabalhando com as áreas para corrigir desvios.
  3. Revisões de Orçamento: Realizar projeções financeiras periódicas, ajustando o orçamento com base nas mudanças de cenário e nas novas previsões de receitas e despesas.
  4. Análise de variações: Analisar as variações entre o realizado e o orçado, investigando as causas das diferenças e propondo ações corretivas.
  5. Relatórios comparativos: Preparar relatórios financeiros detalhados, explicando as variações orçamentárias e fornecendo dados para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
  6. Suporte à tomada de decisão: Fornecer análises financeiras detalhadas para suportar decisões estratégicas, como novos investimentos, expansões ou ajustes operacionais.
  7. Planejamento de cenários: Desenvolver cenários financeiros baseados em diferentes premissas, ajudando a empresa a se preparar para diferentes possibilidades de mercado e desempenho.
  8. Apoio ao planejamento de longo prazo: Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes executivas no planejamento financeiro de médio e longo prazo, considerando as projeções de receitas e necessidades de investimento.
  9. Conciliação de contas: Garantir a correta conciliação contábil de contas que envolvem o orçamento, como contas de receitas, custos e despesas, com as movimentações orçamentárias.
  10. Interface com a contabilidade: Colaborar com a equipe contábil para assegurar que as informações contábeis estejam alinhadas com as projeções orçamentárias.
  11. Análise de rentabilidade de projetos e áreas: Avaliar a rentabilidade de diferentes áreas ou produtos da empresa, colaborando com outros departamentos para otimizar recursos e investimentos.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Ensino superior Completo em Ciências Contabéis, Administração, Economia, ou áreas afins.
  • Domínio do pacote Office.
  • Domínio das normas internacionais de contabilidade (IFRS e CPC's).
  • Análise de balanços.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI.

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

title: SAP - Profitability Analisys
description:
A leading global provider of products and services to the energy industry, embarked on a multi-year transformation journey to streamline,

standardize, and digitalize operations by fully implementing a Global ERP System (S/4HANA).

The Key business goals include strengthening data governance, enhancing platform standardization through a “Clean Core” approach, process optimization

and tax and statutory compliance for each location, with an ongoing focus on rapid response to commercial and operational needs.

To meet these goals, workshop sessions must be addressed for each key workstream to make key design decisions in the following areas:

• Financial Statements design and mapping

• Statutory and tax configuration needs

• Data migration/conversion

• Fixed asset tax booking

• E-Document/e-Invoice + DRC (fit to standard analysis and decision on WRICEF needed)

• TRM (Treasury & Risk Management

This transformation journey began with the a value architecting phase, and currently, the implementation phase is undergoing:

The implementation is split into separate releases for deploying SAP S/4HANA in different locations, covering critical processes such as Order-to-Cash (OTC),

Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Hire-to-Retire (H2R), and Enterprise Asset Management (EAM).

The RTR Team Member for SAP Profitability Analysis and Controlling supports the global finance function by managing and optimizing processes related to product costing,cost center accounting, and profitability analysis (CO-PA) in SAP S/4HANA. The role ensures accurate reporting and control of financial data, enabling strategic decision-making and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the Record-to-Report (RTR) process with a focus on Controlling (CO) and Profitability Analysis (CO-PA) .

  • Configure and maintain cost element accounting , cost center accounting , internal orders , and profit centers in SAP.

  • Set up and support account-based and costing-based CO-PA structures, value fields, and characteristics.

  • UAT support for performing variance analysis, actual vs. planned cost comparisons, and profitability reporting.

  • Monitor and support month-end close activities for CO modules including assessments, distributions, settlements , and allocations .

  • Analyze and resolve system or process issues in collaboration with clients' IT and business stakeholders.

  • Provide input into design of enhancements and process improvements.

  • Document configurations, business processes, and training materials.

  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, policies, and external regulatory requirements.

  • Participate in finance transformation or ERP rollout projects as a subject matter expert for SAP CO and CO-PA.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Controlling (CO) and CO-PA modules (S/4HANA experience preferred).

  • Deep understanding of product costing , cost center planning , profitability reporting , and cost allocations .

  • Experience with financial reporting , variance analysis , and month-end close activities .

  • Strong knowledge of integration points between SAP CO, FI, MM, and SD modules.

  • Ability to interpret financial results and explain profitability drivers.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in a shared services or global business services environment.

  • Experience in profitability analysis for energy, manufacturing or utilities industry .

  • Familiarity with SAP BPC, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) , or Group Reporting is a plus.

  • Professional certifications such as CMA, CPA , or SAP CO certification .

  1. Realizar levantamento de dados técnicos para especificação completa de materiais e componentes eletromecânicos industriais e de equipamentos de mina para as unidades de cimento, concreto e agregados.

  5. Realizar o controle das solicitações de cadastros, modificações, ampliações e/ou manutenção dos materiais existentes no sistema SAP ambiente CADMAT.
  6. Realizar leitura e interpretação de catálogos e desenhos técnicos para abertura de processos de cadastros.
  7. Realizar reuniões de esclarecimento de dados técnicos junto as equipes de Engenharia de Manutenção e/ou PCM - Planejamento e Controle de Manutenção das unidades.
  8. Participar da elaboração de relatórios técnicos gerenciais para controle de produtividade e avanço físico das entregas dos cadastros, modificações, ampliações ou manutenção dos materiais.
  9. Dar as devidas tratativas nos casos de devoluções de processo de cadastros, respondendo e/ou esclarecendo dúvidas técnicas, inserindo catálogos, relatórios técnicos, books, desenhos, projetos e/ou outras informações técnicas complementares.
  10. Garantir informações técnicas fidedignas aos projetos eletromecânicos das unidades e responsabilizar-se pela correta especificação técnica garantindo assertividade nas aquisições, de compras ou de reparos, necessárias ao processo de manutenção das unidades.
  11. Garantir que todos os controles do processo de cadastro estejam corretamente preenchidos nas pastas compartilhadas na rede intranet da CSN.
  12. Entender e cumprir com a Política, Regras e Padrões de Saúde e Segurança (S&S) da CSN Cimentos, mantendo uma cultura sólida de S&S através do senso de dono; da zero tolerância à desvios de saúde e segurança; da execução de ações preventivas e corretivas para atendimento das metas e controle dos riscos ambientais e de incidentes; e da participação nos treinamentos necessários para estar apto a trabalhar de forma segura.
  13. Zelar pela sua própria saúde e segurança e dos demais, interrompendo atividades inseguras, garantindo a aplicação da hierarquia de controle de riscos, realizando o direito de recusa, o cumprimento da política de reconhecimento e consequências e o conhecimento do plano de atendimento emergencial (PAE) da unidade onde estiver atuando.
  14. Aplicar as ferramentas e processos de gerenciamento de riscos e gestão de mudanças, conhecer os riscos associados às atividades e executá-las de forma segura.
  15. Comunicar todos os incidentes.

Somos um dos mais eficientes complexos siderúrgicos integrados do mundo, atuando com destaque em cinco setores: Siderurgia, Mineração, Logística, Cimento e Energia.

A CSN Cimentos é uma das principais empresas do setor de materiais de construção, com foco em cimento, concreto e agregados. Seus produtos e soluções inovadoras são utilizados em diferentes projetos de construção, desde moradias até obras desafiadoras de infraestrutura. A empresa tem uma gestão focada no desenvolvimento de suas equipes e na convivência harmônica com as comunidades nas cidades onde opera.

Com cerca de 3.000 colaboradores a empresa possui um parque industrial distribuído no Sudeste, Nordeste e Centro-Oeste, com mais de 35 unidades no Brasil. Temos o compromisso de seguir todas as normas e recomendações do Pacto Global de ESG. Nosso foco é aumentar a diversidade, incentivando a inclusão, igualdade, respeito e tolerância às diferenças. A CSN Cimentos é signatária dos Princípios de Empoderamento das Mulheres da ONU e no tema de mulheres na liderança é referência na indústria da construção.

Buscamos atrair e desenvolver profissionais que se identifiquem com a nossa cultura. É certificada como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar na Indústria pelo GTPW.

Venha fazer parte da nossa essência: “fazer bem, fazer mais e fazer para sempre

RESPONSABILIDADES:
-Realizar venda de Material de Construção;

-Conhecimento em Material de Construção.

Material de construção

Atendimento ao público

Nossa História:
Em 1967, inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Santo Cristo, um município pequeno do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, mas que já abrigava nossos sonhos imensos. Com coragem e muito trabalho duro, fomos crescendo e levando cada vez mais qualidade para as famílias do interior gaúcho. Nosso objetivo desde o início foi estar ao lado das pessoas, seja no campo ou na cidade. Já nos anos 80, consolidamos o nosso portfólio de materiais de construção, eletrodomésticos e móveis, ficando conhecidos por oferecer uma solução integrada aos nossos consumidores. Nos anos 90, mais um salto de ousadia: agregamos a operação de serviços financeiros. O modelo deu certo e, nos anos 2000, foi expandido e consolidado definitivamente.
Em 2008 a companhia foi adquirida pelo fundo de Private Equity Advent International. Com essa mudança, o centro administrativo muda-se para a região metropolitana de Porto Alegre, no município de Cachoeirinha (RS).
Sempre buscando ir além, em 2010, chegamos em Santa Catarina e no Paraná, ampliando nossa presença em toda a região sul. Também nessa década, lançamos o Programa Palavra, nos tornando o único varejo do país a garantir o produto de graça se a entrega atrasar.
O ano de 2020 é marcado pela abertura de capital(IPO), na bolsa de valores brasileira, uma das maiores conquistas dos mais de cinquenta anos de história da organização.
Em agosto de 2021 marcamos presença em uma nova região do país, o Centro-Oeste, no Estado de Mato Grosso do Sul no município de Eldorado, e em novembro, a inauguramos a primeira loja em São Paulo na cidade de Osvaldo Cruz, dando a certeza de que muito além da venda de produtos para a casa e para a obra, e das soluções financeiras para o dia a dia, realizamos sonhos de muitas pessoas. E como somos inquietos desde o princípio de nossa história chegamos a mais um marco histórico dessa grande trajetória. Juntos, unimos o varejo físico com o virtual para oferecer infinitas oportunidades aos nossos clientes. A realização de um sonho: a Loja Infinita - uma conquista de quem constrói a nossa loja no dia a dia, com proximidade e paixão por atender bem.
Atualmente somos mais de 530 unidades de vendas em 5 Estados do Brasil. Além disso, contamos com 3 centros de distribuição e tudo isso só é possível, graças aos mais de 8.000 colaboradores que fazem parte desta história e sonham junto com a Quero-Quero.

No que acreditamos:
Somos uma organização que acredita que relacionamentos baseados em integridade, simplicidade, confiança e respeito são o que existe de mais importante. Nosso objetivo maior é proporcionar uma vida melhor aos nossos colaboradores, clientes e comunidades onde atuamos. Acreditamos que, ao viver isso com excelência, geraremos o valor e os resultados que nos proporcionarão crescimento constante e sustentável.

Nosso Jeito de Ser:
A cultura da Lojas Quero-Quero é formada por 10 valores que guiam todas as nossas decisões e comportamentos:
INTEGRIDADE
RESPEITO
SIMPLICIDADE
COMPROMETIMENTO
CONFIANÇA
TRANSPARÊNCIA
FOCO NAS PESSOAS
APRENDIZADO CONTÍNUO
TRABALHO EM EQUIPE
AUSTERIDADE
Somos uma equipe que vive estes valores, que se ajuda, e que encara a intensidade do nosso propósito todos os dias. Valorizamos histórias, perfis, vivências e opiniões por acreditar que as diferenças nos complementam e enriquecem a nossa história. Um time que valoriza a diversidade, unindo os diferentes talentos individuais para construímos juntos e juntas uma cultura do respeito, acolhimento e valorização.

Nossos Diferenciais:
Uma pessoa verdadeiramente Quero-Quero, busca equilibrar o compromisso, a verdade e a empatia para a construção da empresa dos sonhos. E a base de nosso relacionamento se dá através das nossas Verdades Fundamentais:
Prometa somente o que pode ser cumprido, mas cumpra tudo o que prometer, custe o que custar.
Fale sempre a verdade, sempre, doa a quem doer.
Faça aos outros o que você gostaria que fosse feito a você.

title: Engineering Manager, Device Intelligence - Brazil
description:
About the Team

The Identity Intelligence team's mission is to eliminate threats and empower the growth of the DoorDash business by providing the source of truth for User Identity and the relationships of connected identifiers. We provide protection across DoorDash's external-facing endpoints. We are making dedicated investments into this space to drive major business impact for teams across DoorDash.

Our team is foundational and sits at the intersection of many other teams, serving critical needs related to user identification, attestation, and device intelligence. We envision our systems to be highly reliable, providing the source of truth for identity-related data with high quality, invaluable, and accurate information. This empowers teams to make the best business decisions, whether solving for fraud or unlocking growth.

We are focused on building extensible platforms, enabling teams to easily and quickly leverage the systems to build critical features. Improving engineering velocity with self-serve tooling and seamless end-to-end integrations that can deliver data insights from the client to the backend system is a key priority.

Our domain currently includes:

  • Identity Graph: Providing the source of truth for User Identities and relationships between all entities.
  • Attestation: Ensuring all requests to DoorDash servers are legitimate, including protection against bot traffic.
  • Device: Uniquely and accurately identifying physical devices that access DoorDash and providing device-related insights.

About the Role

As the Engineering Manager, Identity Intelligence, you will oversee a talented group of engineers, collaborating closely with designers, product managers, operations, and other cross-functional partners. Your primary responsibility will be driving the successful execution of our product roadmap, ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality solutions that meet both customer needs and business objectives. You will be key in fostering a collaborative and cross-functional work environment and promoting effective communication and synergy amongst team members. This role is ideal for a strategic thinker with strong leadership skills who can balance technical excellence with business priorities, especially in the critical domain of identity and security. You will report into Arjun Mukhopadhyay ( ).

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead and grow a team of exceptional engineers, empowering through delegation, and delivering end-to-end engineering solutions for Identity Intelligence systems.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Business leaders, and key stakeholders to determine the team's roadmap and vision, and manage execution against that roadmap, focusing on the strategic technical vision for Identity Graph, Attestation, and Device Intelligence.
  • Provide architectural guidance and professional development for a team of 5+, particularly in the context of building reliable, scalable, and extensible platforms for identity data.
  • Encourage innovation, teamwork, implementation of cutting-edge technologies (including ML-based solutions), and outside-of-the-box thinking to address complex identity and security challenges.
  • Oversee the hiring process for your team, in partnership with recruiting, to grow a diverse and inclusive team with expertise in areas like distributed systems, data engineering, and security.

We're excited about you because you have…

  • BS, M.S., or PhD. in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in people management leading backend teams of 5+ engineers including a staff engineer.
  • 7+ years of industry experience.
  • Experience working with remote teams in different time zone(s) and fluency in English.
  • Extensive experience as an engineer in a fast-paced, product-focused development environment.
  • Experience with distributed system design, system scaling, and performance optimization, especially in the context of data-intensive and security-critical systems.
  • Hands-on leadership and strong product intuition, with a keen understanding of identity and security concerns.
  • Humility - willing to get into the details and open to feedback.
  • Growth mindset - you're eager to expand your skill set and excited to carve out your career path in a hyper-growth setting.
  • Adaptability, resiliency, and ability to thrive in ambiguity - things can change quickly, and you'll need to help the team evolve.
  • Familiarity with concepts related to Identity Graph, Attestation, and Device Intelligence
  • Understanding of data quality, monitoring, and analytics in the context of identity data.
  • Interest in exploring and implementing ML-based solutions for identity and security challenges.

The DoorDash Recruiting Team is focused on building DoorDash culture, one quality hire at a time. We partner with hiring teams to execute recruiting strategies that help DoorDash to hire qualified candidates in the most efficient and unbiased ways.

We're looking for a Sr. Manager of Technical Recruiting to oversee our hiring efforts as we build out our São Paulo, Brazil location. We’re focused on improvement — from moving faster to leveling up the quality of our product — and our work is never complete. Joining DoorDash means working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your ideas can shape products, impact millions of users, and help merchants, Dashers, and customers thrive. We value creativity, ownership, and continuous learning — and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow their careers while making a real difference.

We also care deeply about our team’s well-being. DoorDash offers comprehensive benefits, including premium healthcare, paid parental leave, wellness reimbursements, and more — because we believe that when our people thrive, our communities thrive too.

The Sr. Manager, Technical Recruiting - Brazil will be responsible for developing and driving our recruiting strategy at scale. You will lead the hiring strategy and execution across our technical hiring teams investing in Brazil, and report directly to the Sr. Director, Technical Recruiting in our People organization.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will...

  • Lead DoorDash’s technical recruiting strategy in São Paulo with a focus on acquiring top diverse talent to meet our current and future hiring needs.

  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of processes, tools, and systems needed to scale and support the recruiting team in both the short and long term.
  • Focus on building out proactive hiring strategies supporting org design, succession planning, and always-on talent pipeline.
  • Develop employment brand opportunities and partner with our cross-functional teams to create one-to-many strategic talent engagements with prospective talent pools.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have at least 10 years of recruiting or equivalent business experience, with at least 5 years of experience leading and managing high-performing teams within a hyper-growth environment at progressive companies.
  • You are proficient in both English and Portuguese.
  • You are an authentic, inspiring and hands-on leader with experience driving, building and scaling recruiting teams in hyper-growth environments.
  • You are a beacon for the best recruiters — they seek you out and will follow you anywhere.
  • You build trusted relationships with people at all levels, across multiple functions and in all geographies.
  • You have a bias for action and have an inner drive and fierce commitment to excel in the pursuit of business goals.
  • You possess a penchant for seeking out new experiences, knowledge, and candid feedback and an openness to learning and change.
  • You have the courage to take on difficult goals and bounce back from adversity in the face of challenges.
  • You have an understanding of technology and/or logistics industries and extensive experience leading in-house, geographically dispersed recruiting teams.
  • You're skilled at using data and analytics to develop insights and drive decisions.
  • You have a strong point of view on how diversity and inclusion play a key role in a company’s success, track record of leading teams to achieve diversity recruiting goals, and proven success working with internal and external diversity partners.
  • You have adaptable and superior communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation) at all levels (individual contributor to executive level).

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 27 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 13 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas" .

E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 11 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

title: Engineering Manager- Ceph & Distributed Storage
description:
Join to apply for the Engineering Manager- Ceph & Distributed Storage role at Canonical

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager- Ceph & Distributed Storage role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Ceph & Distributed Storage. The world creates more than 2.5 quintillion bytes of data every day! We want to help teams to store data in open source storage on commodity hardware - safely, cheaply and simply.
Our goal is to make Ceph easy to install, manage and use - from large enterprise data center installations to half-rack edge sites. We believe that distributed storage shouldn't be hard - and to keep up with the increasing data storage demands, it needs to be easier than ever before. We have a range of tools to bring to bear on the problem, and we're excited to make distributed Ceph easy enough that everyone does it.
As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.
What you'll do

  • You will lead a team building a Ceph focused software defined storage solution
  • You will build and manage a globally distributed team of engineers
  • You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring and feedback
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders
  • Advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events
Who you are
  • You have a software engineering background, preferably with Python and C++ experience
  • You have experience operating scale out storage clusters on Linux in production environments, preferably with Ceph
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possibleYou love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers towards delivering timely, high quality software together
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Regional Director, LATAM São Paulo, Brazil
description:
Interested in working on cutting-edge blockchain technology and creating equitable access to the global financial system? Since 2014, the mission-driven team at the Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) has helped fuel the tremendous growth of the Stellar blockchain network, an open-source platform that operates at high-scale today. Developers and companies around the world build on it, and the SDF team is expanding to support the rapidly growing and changing Stellar ecosystem.

We are looking for a seasoned Regional Director to help drive business development efforts across LATAM for SDF. The person in this role will serve as a key regional public-facing voice and thought leader helping to educate and inform the region about the Stellar ecosystem. This person will further create organizational efficiency by assisting with coordination of all SDF activity in that area - from business development focused on developers up through large regional financial institutions, to event representation and planning, to policy and regulatory initiatives. They will support the broader partnership team and company objectives, and will be close partners and shared owners of all primary OKRs.

In this role, your responsibilities will include:

  • Business development work related to our core priorities on expanding DeFi, increasing monthly addresses, and driving asset tokenization, in coordination with Leads of each partnership vertical to drive relevant outcomes. These include surfacing opportunities based on SDF's needs, as well as helping to close deals brought by other members of BD and SDF.
  • Assisting on regulatory and government relations needs in region, helping support the Legal, Policy and Government Relations teams.
  • Assisting the Ecosystem team to identify, plan, and run events in region.

You have:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience with a proven track record of success in business development roles within the blockchain, fintech, or financial services industries.
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience in the blockchain industry, either at a blockchain company or in a role working on blockchain technology and use cases.
  • Strong understanding of the cryptocurrency landscape and experience working with crypto exchanges, custodians, and asset tokenization platforms.
  • A high degree of accountability with STRONG ability to communicate regional progress and all outcomes at frequent intervals to stakeholders.
  • Ability to work in a collaborative team environment, with multiple stakeholders, while often working remotely from said team.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to develop and maintain professional relationships with a network of senior-level professionals, as well as sound judgment, poise in professional settings, and self-awareness.
  • Self-starter with an entrepreneurial drive.
  • The ability to travel as needed, with frequent representation of Stellar at regional meetings and conferences.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Existing relationships within the crypto ecosystem, particularly with a focus on tokenization and decentralized finance.
  • Existing relationships with financial institutions, particularly on the asset management side.

We offer competitive pay for this position depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition, we offer lumen-denominated grants along with other perks and benefits.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About the Stellar Development Foundation

The Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) is a non-profit organization focused on working with and supporting changemakers to create equitable access to the global financial system through blockchain technology. SDF provides grants, investments, funding, and other awards to builders and organizations. SDF also develops resources and tooling on the Stellar network to help unlock real-world utility. As a nonprofit foundation, SDF puts the health of the Stellar network and the Stellar ecosystem and its mission above all else.

SDF is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. SDF does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

O profissional irá desenvolver software com foco em soluções de RH e Folha de Pagamento, tornando o RH dos nossos clientes cada vez + Digital. Além disso, terá como principal missão ser o responsável por apoiar na maximização do valor dos produtos do segmento RH, propondo novas soluções e avaliando alternativas para implementação da área de produto, visando a satisfação do cliente e melhoria contínua das soluções de RH.

O Product Owner (PO) determina as diretrizes estratégicas do produto, define o planejamento de entregas, direciona a squad com feedbacks e apoio para o cumprimento das diretrizes estratégicas. Seu maior desafio é definir e assegurar que a squad saiba, em detalhes, o que se espera para sua entrega de produto.   • Estabelecer relacionamento com clientes, fornecedores e stakeholders, mantendo contato constante, realizando visitas, efetuando levantamentos das eventuais necessidades e se posicionando frente aos possíveis acionamentos;
  • Capturar requisitos de negócios e regulatórios, resolvendo ambiguidades, e transformá-los em conhecimento explícito, através da criação de histórias e critérios de aceite alinhados com a necessidade do cliente.

title: Senior Data Quality & Governance Engineer
description:
Bold Metrics is the leading fit and sizing solution on the market today for the world’s top retailers and brands. We are a venture-backed startup that is making a big impact on the environment, forever changing the landscape of eCommerce. We are a remote-first company that is full of inspiring and friendly people.

We are currently searching for a Senior Data Quality Engineer to join our fast-growing team. This position is for someone located in São Paulo, Brazil who is able to come into the office in-person at least once weekly. In this position, you will have the opportunity to work with some of our biggest projects within the retail industry.

About You:

You are a humble, passionate, and experienced engineer that is looking for a collaborative and analytical Data Quality Engineering role to support the execution of our product deliveries and client reporting services. This comprises validating the data flow as a whole, from data sources to data consumers, including BI dashboards and ML models.

As our Senior Data Quality Engineer, you are an extremely detail-oriented, out-of-the-box problem solver with a commitment to doing high-quality work. You will work with the Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams to support the flow of cleaned, quality data to ultimately drive customer success.

How You Will Make an Impact:

  • Lead the data quality engineering team and efforts across the organization
  • Identify metrics used to measure data quality
  • Establish data validations that cover both functional and domain-specific KPI data
  • Monitor data quality metrics and perform root cause analysis of data quality issues, taking appropriate steps to address any issues
  • Make sure that data quality processes are integrated into the data architecture
  • Support all the data governance initiatives
  • Understand the data and KPI reporting requirements for clients, ensuring that the data quality initiatives align

Skills and Qualifications: (even if you do not meet these skills 100%, we still welcome you to apply)

  • BSc or MSc in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or related field
  • 6+ years’ experience in data engineering and quality assessment roles
  • High level of proficiency with Python and SQL
  • Some experience with DBT would be a bonus
  • A strong understanding of data management concepts including data profiling and mapping
  • Skilled in performing data quality assessments to identify data inconsistencies, inaccuracies, and incompleteness in data products
  • Strong analytical skills to identify patterns and trends in data and data quality issues
  • Good understanding of data governance concepts including data privacy and security
  • A mindset of continuous improvement, identifying areas for improvement within the data quality process and workflows
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve data quality issues, including identifying the root cause of problems and implementing effective solutions
  • Above-bar communication skills, both written and oral, to interface in a collaborative team environment
  • Well-organized individual that pays close attention to detail
  • Able to effectively prioritize in a fast-paced and fast-changing environment
  • Bonus if you have experience integrating with large retail e-commerce sites

About Us:

Bold Metrics, established in 2017, is a SaaS solution for retailers and brands to reduce returns, improve sustainability and supercharge their supply chain from the ground up. Using a comprehensive set of machine learning and AI technologies to accurately capture customer body measurements, we help apparel brands unlock the power of body data to meet the demands of today's increasingly personalized world.

Learn more about us at boldmetrics.com

We strive to create a place to work where we all feel safe, empowered, engaged, and inspired. Position Summary
Bentley Systems is seeking a talented individual to become a valued member of the Product Support team as a Technical Support Engineer. As part of the Global Technical Support team, the technical support engineer is responsible for providing technical assistance on the product via (inbound/outbound) phone, e-mail, and web portal. This is a hands-on position that will interface with our users as well as our development, professional services, and sales departments. The position is responsible for problem analysis, documentation, resolution, and escalation involving Bentley’s supported products
We Will Rely On You For The Following

  • Provide troubleshooting and technical assistance for ProjectWise Product functionality/features to users via e-mail, service tickets, phone, and web-portal (BE Communities.
  • Assist with all facets of Bentley users and technical support by helping to identify user issues by isolating and resolving the issue or by proper escalation.
  • Advise and educate users on accurate usage of the Product and address specific use cases reported on the Service Requests.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment while collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Act as a liaison between users and Product Management/Development.
  • Research and identify solutions to ProjectWise Product functionality/features.
  • Ask users targeted questions to quickly understand the root of the problem.
  • Maintain accurate notes and details on user support requests.
  • Properly escalate unresolved issues to appropriate internal teams (e.g., software developers).
  • Communicate with team members regarding current/ongoing issues via daily scrum calls.
  • Document software problem defects for review and take corrective actions.
  • Document technical knowledge in the form of Knowledgebase Articles or Communities Posts.
  • Meet with internal Bentley teams to provide the users’ perspective on our products and services.

Your Daily Tasks Will Look Like This
  • Review individual Support Case Backlog and prioritize Aged and Escalated Requests.
  • Reproduce issues in-house on test systems (Virtual Machines) to isolate the cause of the problem.
  • Monitor the Team Support Cases Queue and pick issues in the order of priority, impact, and age of the Service Request.
  • Update and follow-up with users over the phone/email on existing Requests.
  • Engage on Team Scrum calls to discuss issues and liaison with the team
  • Adhere to Phone Queue Schedule and ensure phones are always manned and voicemails processed.
  • Contribute to Bentley Communities and answer user queries.
  • Update the Team Technical Knowledge Base and share updates with the team.
  • Upskill on Product Knowledge by focusing on a new topic every week. Consume Training through internal Pathways, Wikis, videos, etc.
  • Channelize potential Defects/Enhancements to the Product Management/Development teams.
  • Provide a handover to the next shift with appropriate documentation when needed

What You Bring To The Team
  • 2+ years of experience in technical support and exposure to global user interaction.
  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Experience or Knowledge with ProjectWise product suites or similar document management systems such as Documentum, Vault or Aconex.
  • Experience with the Administration of Engineering Information/Document Management systems.
  • Experience or knowledge with relational databases: Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle.
  • Experience or knowledge with Networking (DNS, TCP\IP, FQDN, cluster environments).
  • Experience or knowledge with Windows Operating System (Server and client) for administration and debugging.
  • A "user first" approach and strong critical thinking, with a desire to solve problems with excellent troubleshooting skills.
  • Emotional intelligence when talking with users, and the ability to document methodically.
  • Exposure to answering queries via Service Requests and Communities forum posts.
  • Ability to work well with Global colleagues to help address user issues.
  • Ability to manage time effectively by delegating, prioritizing, and scheduling tasks to ensure they are completed in the expected timelines.
  • A motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and in a team.

What Would Make You Stand Out
  • Experience with ProjectWise infrastructure.
  • Knowledge or experience of IIS (Internet Information Services),
  • Proven success in all aspects of ProjectWise Administration.
  • Experience with MicroStation, AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D, IPLOT (Printing\Plotting).
  • Knowledge with extended ProjectWise features (Publishing such as ICS for PDF, BAS; Bentley cloud features such as Deliverables Management, ProjectWise Drive, ProjectWise Projects, WSG, etc.)

What We Offer
  • A great Team and culture – please see our Recruitment Video.
  • An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction.
  • Competitive Salary and benefits.
  • The opportunity to work within a global and diverse international team.
  • A supportive and collaborative environment.
  • Colleague Recognition Awards.

Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. description:

Join to apply for the Analyst, Infrastructure 16468 role at GIC

GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 offices around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.
Infrastructure
We deploy long-term capital through direct, and fund investments across the capital structure to diversify our portfolio. You will help to preserve and enhance the value of our direct private and public equity investments, working with top management teams and board of directors.
The Sao Paulo team was established in 2015, and currently has nine investment professionals. The team is focused on analyzing opportunities in South and Central America, as well as managing the investments made since 2013 in the region. It is integrated into the global team which operates from London, New York, Singapore and Sao Paulo.
Illustrative investments include Aegea (water and sanitation in Brazil), CART/Eixo SP (toll roads in Brazil), V.tal (fiber optics in Brazil), Neoenergia Transmission (power transmission in Brazil), NTS (gas pipeline in Brazil) and Isagen (power generation in Colombia), amongst others. GIC Infrastructure approaches investments with a buy and hold perspective and manages assets with a long-term perspective. We focus on minority / co-control investments alongside industrial and financial partners and have consolidated ourselves as one of the most active investors in the sector and region.
We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our Sao Paulo team as an Analyst. GIC desires to become the leading long term global infrastructure investor and an outstanding career path is available for high performers.
What Impact Can You Make In This Role
You will be part of a team that invests into infrastructure companies with stable and predictable cash flows, reasonable risk-adjusted returns and strong impact to local economies.
What You Will Do As An Analyst

  • Play a central role in growing GIC Infrastructure’s portfolio and supporting existing investments in the region.
  • Under the supervision of the senior team, play an integral role in the full deal lifecycle: deal screening, approvals, execution, asset management and, when appropriate, exits.
  • Take on primary role in the financial modeling of transactions, deal with senior management, external advisors and banks.
  • Play a key part in deal screening and appraisal, contributing to transaction analysis, and helping prepare the documentation to support investment decisions to investment committee.
  • Investment focus is likely to be biased towards, but not limited to, the power, midstream, transportation, digital infrastructure and water utility sectors. No experience in infrastructure sectors is required, but the candidate will be required to conduct financial research on public and private companies for potential acquisitions.
  • The team operates in a flat and meritocratic culture, empowering staff with open communications and robust challenges. Being a team player and interacting with counterparties in a way that builds on our reputation is everyone’s responsibility.

What makes you a successful candidate?
  • Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university with coursework emphasizing business administration, economics, accounting, finance, and/or engineering. Graduation date between June 2024 and June 2025.
  • Previous experience working for a private equity fund, institutional investors, or for investment banks as part of the M&A advisory or Equity research team. Experience in the infrastructure sector is not required.
  • Outstanding financial modelling skills are assumed and will be tested. The ability to build models from scratch is required, as well as model review and scenario development.
  • You will be detail-oriented with a hands-on attitude to deal execution and will thrive in a culture of high-expectations and personal responsibility to own the investment.
  • Strong commercial and intellectual curiosity is a requirement to perform well and advance.

Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-Term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.
Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office at least four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.
We are an equal opportunity employer
As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.
Learn More
Learn more about our Infrastructure Department here: PRIME Values
GIC is a values driven organization. GIC’s PRIME Values act as our compass, enabling us to fulfil our fundamental purpose and objectives. It is the foundational bedrock which governs our behaviors, our decision making, and our focus. It informs both our long-term strategy as a firm, and the way we relate to our Client, business partners and employees. PRIME stands for Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence.

ATRIBUIÇÕES PRINCIPAIS

  1. Executar os procedimentos privativos e relacionados a práticas avançadas de enfermagem como interagir com pais/ responsáveis antes, durante e após procedimentos, orientações realizadas, realizar e orientar diluições e rediluições de medicamentos conforme faixa etária/ peso/ restrição hídrica, realizar punção venosa considerando protocolo de punção difícil para todas as crianças, acompanhar pacientes em exames com sedação e realizar procedimentos invasivos específicos como punção venosa, atendimento de urgência;
  2. Realizar procedimentos invasivos preferencialmente em dupla através das diretrizes do modelo assistencial para garantir as melhores práticas institucionais;
  3. Receber o plantão e proceder a assistência direta aos pacientes, observando, acompanhando, reconhecendo sinais/sintomas e registrando as ações e, ao término do plantão informar e esclarecer a assistência prestada aos pacientes através da passagem de plantão em instrumento estruturado institucional;
  4. Realizar e planejar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE) estabelecendo níveis de responsabilidade na execução das ações planejadas entre equipe de enfermagem, avaliando os resultados e registrando-os durante a internação, através das necessidades de cada paciente.
  5. Coordenar processos que garantam uma assistência segura e de qualidade a todos os pacientes sob sua responsabilidade nas diferentes situações críticas, através das diretrizes institucionais, a fim de garantir uma assistência segura;
  6. Aprazar e conferir os itens de prescrição médica para continuidade da assistência segura;
  7. Reconhecer e priorizar de acordo com a complexidade assistencial as situações de emergência mediante a necessidade de cada paciente, direcionando a assistência a ser prestada, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir as normas, regulamentos e legislações pertinentes às áreas de atuação, contribuir para a elaboração e implementação de manuais técnicos operacionais para a equipe de enfermagem nos diversos setores de atuação e de manuais educativos aos clientes e familiares;
  8. Promover e participar da integração da equipe multiprofissional, procurando garantir uma assistência integral ao cliente e familiares;
  9. Apoiar demais setores, conforme direcionamento de liderança, viabilizando o atendimento de todos os pacientes internados no HSC;
  10. Participação ativa em visita multidisciplinar buscando o alinhamento das necessidades assistenciais dos pacientes e familiares sob sua responsabilidade;
  11. Garantir a comunicação ativa junto a equipe multidisciplinar visando facilitar o planejamento e execução das ações pertinentes as boas práticas e contribuir com o desenvolvimento do colaborador, através de educação em atividades baseadas em normas, protocolos e procedimentos institucionais, visando a atualização e aperfeiçoamento da equipe de enfermagem;
  12. Realizar o acompanhamento e treinamento de colaboradores recém-admitidos, com exercício de mesma função assistencial;
  13. Garantir as ações de preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos da unidade, preservando o funcionamento adequado conforme políticas institucionais;
  14. Exercer as atividades baseado nos protocolos institucionais na busca da prevenção e controle sistemático de danos a pacientes durante a assistência de saúde através do cumprimento das metas de segurança do paciente;
  15. Participar dos treinamentos e eventos institucionais pertinentes ao cargo;
  16. Multiplicar informações relacionadas a boas práticas assistenciais junto a equipe multidisciplinar de área de atuação, promovendo e difundindo medidas de prevenção de riscos e agravos por meio da educação paciente e familiares, objetivando melhorar a qualidade de vida do paciente;
  17. Realizar notificações de não conformidades e eventos identificados visando manter a qualidade e segurança da assistência prestada;
  18. Executar as práticas de segurança através do cumprimento das normativas da NR-32, medicina ocupacional, SCIH e SEST.

Sobre a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC)

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a ACSC é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO

Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO

Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES

Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

  4. Aprender a trabalhar com ferramentas de inteligência de negócios, acessar e trabalhar com big data de várias fontes e fazer parceria com áreas da empresa para identificar oportunidades estratégicas.

title: IT Solutions Release Manager - Mid-senior
description:
Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

The group's key figures are approximately: Turnover of 6.5 billion euros, more than 940 laboratories in 62 countries and around 62,000 employees.

Job Description

SUMMARY OF POSITION AND OBJECTIVES:

The Release Manager role will be responsible for deploying builds across the environment, on-boarding new environment , Handling transversal projects and create release management related document and share release plan with the stakeholders

  • Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
  • Facilitate release activities across all releases, mainly with ensuring quality, timely deployments across environments
  • Maintains the release schedule for all core services and ensure alignment across key partners and vendors.
  • Coordinate release content and effort based on the service request backlog, pending service requests, third party applications, or operating system updates
  • Communicate all key project plans, commitments, and changes including QA plans, schedule, and scope changes.
  • Conduct Release Readiness reviews, Milestone Reviews, and Business Go/No-Go reviews with stakeholders
  • Produce Deployment, Run Books and Implementation Plans
  • Participate in CAB meetings to present Production changes (RFCs)
  • Lead and co-ordinate the Go-Live activities including the execution of the deployment Plans and checklists.
  • Weekly Release Reporting with Program release manager.
  • Own and continually improve the release process by documenting release issues and developing plans to improve processes, able to recommend continuous improvements viz: automation .
  • Comfortable in interacting with people across hierarchical levels for smooth project execution. Enjoys managing complex projects involving challenges.
Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • English Language is mandatory to collaborate in a global environment, including writing, speaking and presenting.
  • Understanding of Continuous Delivery and Continuous Integration (CD/CI) pipelines
  • Good understanding of cloud deployment, preferably Azure and Agile practice
  • Knowledge on Deployment tool like Octopus
  • Knowledge on MS Project, Excel-Macros
  • Document Management for adhere to Audit Compliance process is an added advantage
  • 4 to 5 years of relevant release and deployment management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional work teams towards task completion
  • Demonstrated effective leadership and analytical skills
  • Strong in troubleshooting and organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
    Desired Technical Stack:
  • Platforms : Windows, Linux.
  • Database : MSSQL
  • Ticketing Tools: Service now
  • Cloud Environment : MS Azure
  • CI and Build Deployment Tools : Octopus Deploy
  • Version Control Tool : Azure Devops
  • Monitoring tools : Grafana
Additional Information

Working hours:
Monday to Friday - 08:00 to 17:00 Hybrid Work

title: Trainmaster (CVRR)
description:
Supervises and coordinates activities of train crew engaged in switching railroad cars within yard of railroad, industrial plant, or similar location to facilitate loading or unloading of cars or making up and breaking up of trains; and/or switches railroad cars within yard of railroad, industrial plant, or similar location to load and unload cars or to make up or break up trains in a safe and efficient manner, by performing the following duties.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities :

  • Supervises and coordinates the activities of train crews.
  • Receives oral or written instructions from Manager or Customer indicating which cars are to be switched.
  • Notifies train crew of switching orders and, whereby, which cars are to be moved to specified locations of yard, using radio, telephone, verbal, or hand signals.
  • Manage cars online through various RMI reports.
  • Must ensure daily train lists are accurate as generated by the customer service department, and accurate as completed by the train crews within his/her territory.
  • Must ensure all reporting is done accurately and timely, including daily crew work sheets and weekly operational reporting.
  • Approve all man hours under his/her area of responsibility and forward these hours to the necessary personnel or department on a timely basis.
  • Initiate and provide an accurate, complete, and timely investigation of all accidents and incidents, including causes, remedial action, and recommended solutions.
  • Understand the quantitative factors contributing to the major costs on the railroad and understand the extent of their effect toward financial performances.
  • Adjust locomotive consist requirements based on HP and trailing tons daily, with a goal to minimize locomotive fuel and maximize locomotive utilization.
  • Understand all outstanding track conditions within his/her territory, including slow orders, and their effect on productivity/efficiency.
  • Demonstrate predictable, reliable, and timely attendance.
  • Knowledge of and skills in applying basic federal railroad regulations, guidelines, and rules.
  • Ability to read and comprehend written safety rules, procedure and safety manuals, government regulations, operating and maintenance instructions, memos, and other work-related information.
  • Ability to apply commonsense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, diagrammatic, or schedule form; and/or to apply principles of logic to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions; and/or to apply principles of rational systems to solve practical problems.
  • Ability to effectively communicate instructions, directions, processes, procedures, safety rules and regulations to co-workers, supervisors, and others in written, oral, diagrammatic and schedule form.
  • Ability to train switch crews and other yard personnel to perform job-related duties; and to provide training related to federal and company regulations, rules, safety guidelines and preventive maintenance.
  • Ability to make independent judgments using sound reasoning skills and knowledge base.
  • Ability to think and act quickly in responding to emergency and non-emergency situations.
  • Ability to talk to and effectively communicate with co-workers, yard personnel, switching crew, engineers, railroad officials and others in a clear, concise, courteous, efficient, and professional manner.
  • Promote and facilitate company safety initiatives and instill a culture of safety
  • Manages the operational testing program by observing, documenting, and evaluating safe work practices and rules compliance
  • Ability to pass training and required testing.
  • Performs other duties as requested or required

Machines, Tools, Special Equipment, Personal Protective Equipment Used:

  • PPE; hard hat, vest, safety glasses, FR clothing, gloves, steel toed boots

Education and Experience:

  • High school education or general education development (GED), and minimum of 6 months job-related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability to pass training and required testing.

Certificates and Licenses:

  • Must hold, and continue to hold, a current locomotive engineers and conductor’s certification.

Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The team member is regularly exposed to outside weather conditions and elements, noise, and fumes from gas, oil, and grease.

Note: The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by team members assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.

Os cursos, realizados em parceria com o Serviço Nacional de Aprendizagem Rural (SENAR), oferecem uma ampla variedade de temas que vão desde capacitações técnicas até desenvolvimento pessoal. Entre as opções oferecidas estão cursos voltados para a área tecnológica, como operação de drones e prevenção e combate a incêndios, e para o setor agrícola, com capacitações em cultivo de mamão, melancia e banana, além de pulverização agrícola.
